svg.title: Ultra Game Stash
svg.script:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <base target="_top">
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net">
  <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://i.postimg.cc">

  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=VT323&family=Cinzel:wght@500;700&family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@500;700&family=Anton&display=swap">
  <style>
    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      font-family:
        "Comic Sans MS",
        "Comic Sans",
        cursive;
    }
    :root {
      --orange: #ff7900;
      --orange-light: #ffad42;
      --black: #26150b;
      --panel: #3e2212;
      --panel-light: #563019;
      --white: #fff5e9;
      --muted: #c6b8a8;
    }
    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-height: 100vh;
      color: var(--white);
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at top,
          #512300 0%,
          transparent 48%),
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #1e1009,
          #1b0c02 55%,
          #201209);
    }
    button,
    input,
    textarea {
      font: inherit;
    }
    button {
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 10;
      padding: 18px 22px;
      background: rgba(30, 16, 9, .96);
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--orange);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 24px #00000099;
    }
    .brand {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      font-size: clamp(25px, 4vw, 38px);
      font-weight: bold;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      text-shadow: 0 0 16px #ff790055;
    }
    .brand span {
      color: white;
    }
    nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .nav-button {
      border: 1px solid #59300e;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #482815;
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      transition: .2s;
    }
    .nav-button:hover,
    .nav-button.active {
      color: #301a0e;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          var(--orange-light),
          var(--orange));
      border-color: var(--orange-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    main {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: auto;
      padding: 28px 20px 60px;
    }
    .page {
      display: none;
      animation: appear .22s ease;
    }
    .page.active {
      display: block;
    }
    @keyframes appear {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(5px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
    .hero {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 55px 22px;
      border: 1px solid #66340c;
      border-radius: 22px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          140deg,
          #271103,
          #2e190d 65%);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 38px #00000066;
    }
    .hero h1 {
      margin: 0 0 14px;
      font-size: clamp(34px, 6vw, 58px);
      color: var(--orange-light);
      text-shadow: 0 0 22px #ff790044;
    }
    .hero p {
      max-width: 650px;
      margin: 0 auto 22px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: 30px;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      margin: 0 0 8px;
    }
    .section-description {
      color: var(--muted);
      margin: 0 0 24px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }
    .grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 18px;
      margin-top: 22px;
    }
    .card {
      padding: 20px;
      border: 1px solid #3c291a;
      border-radius: 17px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #522d18,
          #321c0f);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 22px #00000044;
      overflow-wrap: anywhere;
    }
    .card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      font-size: 21px;
    }
    .card p {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .button {
      display: inline-block;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 11px 17px;
      color: #301a0e;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #ffb64f,
          #ff7900);
      font-weight: bold;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: transform .2s, filter .2s;
    }
    .button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      filter: brightness(1.12);
    }
    .button.secondary {
      color: var(--white);
      border: 1px solid #5c3518;
      background: #5a321a;
    }
    .button-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }
    .announcement-date {
      color: #ffad42;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .gаmе-image {
      display: block;
      width: calc(100% + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center;
      margin: -20px -20px 14px;
      border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0;
      background: #2e190d;
    }
    .field {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 12px;
      margin: 6px 0 12px;
      border: 1px solid #49301c;
      border-radius: 10px;
      outline: none;
      color: white;
      background: #2e190d;
    }
    .field:focus {
      border-color: var(--orange);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ff790022;
    }
    textarea.field {
      resize: vertical;
      min-height: 90px;
    }
    label {
      display: block;
      color: var(--orange-light);
    }
    .status {
      color: var(--muted);
      min-height: 22px;
      margin: 10px 0;
    }
    .footer {
      text-align: center;
      color: #988a7c;
      padding: 28px 12px;
      border-top: 1px solid #39210f;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .settings-launcher {
      position: fixed;
      right: 18px;
      bottom: 18px;
      z-index: 1000;
      width: 54px;
      height: 54px;
      border: 2px solid #ffad42;
      border-radius: 50%;
      color: #fff5e9;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #3b1b05,
          #301a0e);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 22px #000000aa, 0 0 15px #ff790044;
      font-size: 25px;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      transition: transform .2s, background .2s;
    }
    .settings-launcher:hover {
      transform: rotate(25deg) scale(1.06);
    }
    .settings-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1001;
      display: none;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 18px;
      background: #000000bb;
      backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
    }
    .settings-overlay.open {
      display: flex;
    }
    .settings-dialog {
      width: min(100%, 480px);
      max-height: min(85vh, 700px);
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 24px;
      border: 1px solid #ff7900;
      border-radius: 20px;
      color: var(--white);
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #241105,
          #2e190d 70%);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 60px #000000cc, 0 0 28px #ff790022;
    }
    .settings-heading {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }
    .settings-heading h2 {
      margin: 0;
      color: var(--orange-light);
    }
    .settings-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 1px solid #68401d;
      border-radius: 10px;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #21170f;
      font-size: 20px;
    }
    .settings-intro {
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .layout-option {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      margin-top: 12px;
      padding: 15px;
      border: 1px solid #523116;
      border-radius: 13px;
      text-align: left;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #171411;
      transition:
        border-color .2s,
        background .2s,
        transform .2s;
    }
    .layout-option:hover {
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      border-color: #ffad42;
    }
    .layout-option.selected {
      border: 2px solid #ff9b2f;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          120deg,
          #422006,
          #1b1510);
    }
    .layout-option strong {
      display: block;
      color: var(--orange-light);
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }
    .layout-option span {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .topbar {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 230px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 26px 14px;
      border-right: 2px solid var(--orange);
      border-bottom: 0;
      box-shadow: 5px 0 25px #00000088;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .brand {
      font-size: 27px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin: 8px 0 28px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar nav {
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .nav-button {
      width: 100%;
      text-align: left;
      padding: 12px 14px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar main {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin-left: 230px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .footer {
      margin-left: 230px;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .hero {
      text-align: left;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .hero p {
      margin-left: 0;
    }
    body.layout-sidebar .hero .button-row {
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight {
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          circle at 88% 9%,
          #613336 0%,
          transparent 22%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 8% 40%,
          #36181a 0%,
          transparent 42%),
        linear-gradient(
          150deg,
          #110c07,
          #1f0e0f 58%,
          #0d0a07);
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .topbar {
      position: relative;
      background: rgba(17, 12, 7, .94);
      border-bottom: 1px solid #663c40;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px #00000055;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .brand,
    body.layout-moonlight .hero h1,
    body.layout-moonlight .section-title,
    body.layout-moonlight .card h3,
    body.layout-moonlight label {
      color: #fcd3cd;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight nav {
      gap: 8px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .nav-button {
      border-color: #624244;
      border-radius: 9px 9px 3px 3px;
      background: #1f1112;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .nav-button:hover,
    body.layout-moonlight .nav-button.active {
      color: #1f0e0f;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #fde2de,
          #f99e90);
      border-color: #fde2de;
      box-shadow: 0 0 18px #f99e902b;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight main {
      max-width: 1180px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.15fr) minmax(210px, .85fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px 34px;
      min-height: 300px;
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 58px);
      text-align: left;
      border: 1px solid #6d4347;
      border-radius: 8px 38px 8px 38px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          115deg,
          #2d1618 0%,
          #1f1112 56%,
          #170d0d 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 44px #00000055, inset 0 0 45px #f885730a;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero::after {
      content: "";
      grid-column: 2;
      grid-row: 1 / span 3;
      justify-self: center;
      width: clamp(130px, 17vw, 205px);
      aspect-ratio: 1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          circle at 34% 30%,
          #fff9f8 0%,
          #fddcd7 26%,
          #daa69e 54%,
          #8a585c 72%,
          #412527 73%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 35px #fab3a955, 0 0 95px #c061692a;
      opacity: .9;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero h1 {
      grid-column: 1;
      margin: 0;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero p {
      grid-column: 1;
      margin: 0;
      max-width: 590px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .hero .button-row {
      grid-column: 1;
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      align-items: stretch;
      gap: 18px;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .card {
      border: 1px solid #5d383b;
      border-radius: 5px 20px 5px 20px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #2c191b,
          #160e0e);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 28px #00000044;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .grid > .card:nth-child(4n+1) {
      grid-row: span 2;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .button {
      color: #210e10;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #fde2de,
          #f99e90);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 18px #f8857322;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .button.secondary {
      color: #fef2f0;
      border-color: #7d4348;
      background: #2a191a;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .field {
      border-color: #7d4348;
      background: #160e0e;
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .footer {
      border-top-color: #5a3235;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      body.layout-moonlight .hero {
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .hero::after {
        display: block;
        width: 105px;
        margin: 24px auto 0;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .hero p {
        margin: 12px auto 20px;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .hero .button-row {
        justify-content: center !important;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      body.layout-moonlight .grid > .card:nth-child(4n+1) {
        grid-row: auto;
      }
    }
    body.layout-bottom {
      padding-bottom: 82px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at top,
          #512300 0%,
          transparent 48%),
        linear-gradient(
          135deg,
          #1e1009,
          #1b0c02 55%,
          #201209);
    }
    body.layout-bottom .topbar {
      position: relative;
      top: auto;
      padding: 22px 20px 16px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #59300e;
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    body.layout-bottom .brand {
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    body.layout-bottom nav {
      position: fixed;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: 12px;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 900;
      width: max-content;
      max-width: calc(100% - 24px);
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: nowrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 7px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      border: 1px solid #8d4a13;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: rgba(12, 10, 8, .96);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px #000000bb, 0 0 18px #ff790022;
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }
    body.layout-bottom .nav-button {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      white-space: nowrap;
      padding: 9px 13px;
      border-radius: 11px;
    }
    body.layout-bottom nav {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    body.layout-bottom main {
      padding-top: 28px;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 22px;
      padding: 14px 24px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--orange);
    }
    body.layout-topbar .brand {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      margin: 0;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: clamp(21px, 2.4vw, 30px);
    }
    body.layout-topbar nav {
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .nav-button {
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    body.layout-topbar main {
      max-width: 1180px;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(220px, .8fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px 36px;
      text-align: left;
      padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 58px);
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero h1 {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero p {
      margin: 0;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .hero .button-row {
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
      margin-top: 0;
    }
    body.layout-topbar .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
    }
    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      body.layout-topbar .topbar {
        display: block;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .brand {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
      }
      body.layout-topbar nav {
        justify-content: center;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .hero {
        display: block;
        text-align: center;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .hero p {
        margin: 0 auto 22px;
      }
      body.layout-topbar .hero .button-row {
        justify-content: center !important;
      }
    }
    body.layout-imac {
      --imac-accent: #fdd1ab;
      padding-bottom: 150px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 50% -10%,
          #604227 0%,
          transparent 48%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 90% 65%,
          #4d2528 0%,
          transparent 38%),
        linear-gradient(
          160deg,
          #180f08,
          #221911 52%,
          #120d09);
    }
    body.layout-imac .topbar {
      position: relative;
      background: rgba(22, 15, 8, .76);
      border-bottom: 1px solid #b9927055;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 28px #00000033;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
    body.layout-imac .brand,
    body.layout-imac .hero h1,
    body.layout-imac .section-title,
    body.layout-imac .card h3 {
      color: #feebda;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav {
      position: fixed !important;
      left: 50% !important;
      right: auto !important;
      top: auto !important;
      bottom: 14px !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%) !important;
      z-index: 1000;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: clamp(7px, 1.2vw, 14px);
      width: max-content;
      max-width: calc(100% - 28px);
      padding: 14px 20px;
      overflow: visible;
      border: 1px solid #feead835;
      border-radius: 25px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          rgba(69, 52, 37, .82),
          rgba(29, 20, 12, .88));
      box-shadow: 0 15px 42px #00000088, inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff20;
      backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(145%);
      scrollbar-width: none;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      flex: 0 0 68px;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 5px;
      width: 68px;
      height: 68px;
      padding: 6px 3px;
      overflow: visible;
      border: 1px solid #ffffff22;
      border-radius: 19px;
      color: #fff6ee;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #654f3b,
          #3f2f21 62%,
          #342619);
      box-shadow: 0 5px 12px #00000055, inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff20;
      font-size: 0;
      line-height: 1;
      white-space: normal;
      transform-origin: center bottom;
      will-change: transform;
      backface-visibility: hidden;
      transition:
        transform .38s cubic-bezier(.2, .75, .25, 1),
        box-shadow .38s ease,
        border-color .32s ease,
        filter .38s ease,
        background .32s ease;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button::before {
      display: block;
      font-size: 27px;
      line-height: 1;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 2px #00000055);
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button::after {
      content: attr(data-dock-label);
      display: block;
      max-width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: #fef4eb;
      font-size: 9px;
      font-weight: 650;
      line-height: 1.1;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      white-space: nowrap;
      letter-spacing: .1px;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=home]::before {
      content: "🏠";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=announcements]::before {
      content: "📣";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=gаmеs]::before {
      content: "🎮";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=сhаt]::before {
      content: "💬";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=about]::before {
      content: "🍁";
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button[data-page=suggestions]::before {
      content: "💡";
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav {
      transition: box-shadow .42s ease, background .42s ease;
    }
    body.layout-imac > nav:has(.nav-button:hover) {
      box-shadow:
        0 19px 48px #00000099,
        0 0 26px #fcbf8a14,
        inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff2b;
    }
    body.layout-imac .nav-button:hover {
      z-index: 4;
      transform: translateY(-13px) scale(1.16);
      border-color: #fee1c7b8;
      box-shadow:
        0 14px 28px #00000099,
        0 0 24px #fcbf8a48,

    body:not(.layout-sidebar):not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-bottom):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) .nav-button,

    body.layout-liquid {
      background-color: #1e1208 !important;
      background-image: none !important;
      background-attachment: scroll !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid::before {
      content: "";
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: -1;
      pointer-events: none;
      background:
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 12% 8%,
          rgba(251, 168, 95, .20),
          transparent 34%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 86% 18%,
          rgba(249, 151, 136, .17),
          transparent 32%),
        radial-gradient(
          ellipse at 50% 100%,
          rgba(217, 140, 73, .13),
          transparent 42%),
        linear-gradient(
          145deg,
          #1e1208 0%,
          #342111 48%,
          #2e2116 100%);
    }
    body.layout-liquid .topbar,
    body.layout-liquid .hero,
    body.layout-liquid .card,
    body.layout-liquid .field,
    body.layout-liquid input,
    body.layout-liquid textarea,
    body.layout-liquid select,
    body.layout-liquid .announcement,
    body.layout-liquid .suggestion-card,
    body.layout-liquid .layout-option,
    body.layout-liquid .footer {
      backdrop-filter: none !important;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid > nav {
      backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(140%) !important;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(26px) saturate(140%) !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid > nav {
      will-change: transform;
    }
    body.layout-liquid > nav .liquid-dock-lens {
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(125%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(125%);
    }
    body.layout-liquid .button,
    body.layout-liquid button:not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close) {
      color: #ffffff !important;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(68, 33, 2, .5);
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          155deg,
          rgba(252, 199, 153, .46),
          rgba(228, 155, 92, .40) 50%,
          rgba(230, 138, 124, .38)) !important;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .55) !important;
      box-shadow:
        0 8px 22px rgba(137, 76, 23, .28),
        inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .7),
        inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .12) !important;

    body.layout-liquid .button:hover,
    body.layout-liquid button:not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close):hover {
      color: #ffffff !important;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(186, 110, 44, .32), inset 0 1.5px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .85) !important;
    }

    body.layout-liquid select option {
      color: #ffffff;
      background: #392411;

    /* ===== Falling autumn leaves (decoration only) ===== */
    #fallLeaves {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .fall-leaf {
      position: absolute;
      top: -10vh;
      opacity: .55;
      will-change: transform;
      animation: leafFall linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes leafFall {
      0%   { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
      50%  { transform: translate3d(45px, 60vh, 0) rotate(190deg); }
      100% { transform: translate3d(-35px, 125vh, 0) rotate(380deg); }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      #fallLeaves { display: none; }
    }

    /* =====================================================================
       SMOOTH ANIMATIONS
       ===================================================================== */
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    /* ---- Page load: header drops in, dock rises, icons pop in one by one ---- */
    @keyframes bodyIn  { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
    @keyframes topIn   { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 -18px; } to { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; } }
    @keyframes dockIn  { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 70px; } to { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; } }
    @keyframes iconPop {
      from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 26px; scale: .4; }
      to   { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0;    scale: 1; }
    }
    body { animation: bodyIn .7s ease backwards; }
    .topbar { animation: topIn .9s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) backwards; }
    body > nav,
    body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav {
      animation: dockIn 1s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) .12s backwards;
    }
    body > nav > .nav-button,
    body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button {
      animation: iconPop .7s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.45, .55, 1) backwards;
      animation-delay: calc(.3s + var(--ni, 0) * 70ms);
    }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(1), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(1) { --ni: 0; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(2), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(2) { --ni: 1; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(3), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(3) { --ni: 2; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(4), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(4) { --ni: 3; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(5), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(5) { --ni: 4; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(6), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(6) { --ni: 5; }
    body > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(7), body.layout-bottom .topbar > nav > .nav-button:nth-of-type(7) { --ni: 6; }

    /* ---- Page switching: old page fades out, new page glides in ---- */
    @keyframes appear {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px) scale(.992); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }
    @keyframes pageOut {
      to { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px) scale(.994); }
    }
    @keyframes riseIn {
      from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 24px; scale: .97; }
      to   { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0;    scale: 1; }
    }
    .page { animation: appear .55s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1); }
    .page.leaving { animation: pageOut .17s ease-in forwards; pointer-events: none; }

    .page.active .section-title,
    .page.active .section-description,
    .page.active .hero > * {
      animation: riseIn .7s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) backwards;
    }
    .page.active .section-description { animation-delay: .06s; }
    .page.active .hero > :nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .07s; }
    .page.active .hero > :nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .14s; }

    .page.active .grid > .card,
    .page.active > .card {
      animation: riseIn .7s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1) backwards;
      animation-delay: calc(.12s + var(--n, 0) * 65ms);
    }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(1) { --n: 0; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(2) { --n: 1; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(3) { --n: 2; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(4) { --n: 3; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(5) { --n: 4; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(6) { --n: 5; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(7) { --n: 6; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(8) { --n: 7; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(9) { --n: 8; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(10) { --n: 9; }
    .grid > .card:nth-child(n+11) { --n: 9; }

    /* ---- Cards, buttons, inputs ---- */
    .card {
      transition:
        transform .45s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1),
        box-shadow .45s ease,
        border-color .45s ease;
    }
    @media (hover: hover) {
      .card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-5px);
        border-color: #ff790066;
        box-shadow: 0 18px 38px #00000066, 0 0 24px #ff790022;
      }
    }
    .card:has(> img) { overflow: hidden; }
    .card > img {
      transition: opacity .7s ease, filter .5s ease;
    }
    .card > img:not(.is-loaded) { opacity: 0; }
    @media (hover: hover) {
      .card:hover > img { filter: brightness(1.12) saturate(1.1); }
    }

    .button {
      transition:
        transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1),
        filter .3s ease,
        box-shadow .35s ease;
    }
    body .button:active,
    body button:not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close):active {
      transform: translateY(0) scale(.96) !important;
      transition-duration: .08s !important;
    }

    .nav-button {
      transition:
        transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1),
        background .35s ease,
        color .35s ease,
        border-color .35s ease,
        box-shadow .35s ease;
    }
    body:not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid) .nav-button:active {
      transform: scale(.95);
      transition-duration: .08s;
    }

    .field {
      transition: border-color .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, background .3s ease;
    }

    /* ---- Smooth fade between layouts (View Transitions) ---- */
    ::view-transition-old(root),
    ::view-transition-new(root) {
      animation-duration: .5s;
      animation-timing-function: cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1);
    }

    /* =====================================================================
       SETTINGS: pops out of the gear button, like opening an app on a Mac
       ===================================================================== */
    .settings-launcher {
      transition:
        transform .65s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1),
        background .3s ease,
        box-shadow .3s ease;
    }
    .settings-launcher:active {
      transform: scale(.9);
      transition-duration: .1s;
    }
    .settings-launcher[aria-expanded="true"] {
      transform: rotate(90deg) scale(.92);
    }

    /* The overlay is always laid out, just hidden, so it can animate both ways. */
    .settings-overlay {
      display: flex !important;
      visibility: hidden;
      pointer-events: none;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(0px);
      backdrop-filter: blur(0px);
      transition:
        background-color .5s ease,
        -webkit-backdrop-filter .5s ease,
        backdrop-filter .5s ease,
        visibility 0s linear .55s;
    }
    .settings-overlay.open {
      visibility: visible;
      pointer-events: auto;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(125%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(125%);
      transition-delay: 0s, 0s, 0s, 0s;
    }

    /* Closed = a tiny round blob sitting exactly on the gear button. */
    .settings-dialog {
      margin: auto;
      transform-origin: 50% 50%;
      transform: translate3d(var(--gx, 0px), var(--gy, 0px), 0) scale(var(--gs, .11));
      opacity: 0;
      border-radius: 200px;
      will-change: transform, opacity;
      transition:
        transform .5s cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1),
        opacity .26s ease .14s,
        border-radius .5s cubic-bezier(.65, 0, .35, 1);
    }
    .settings-overlay.open .settings-dialog {
      transform: none;
      opacity: 1;
      border-radius: 22px;
      transition:
        transform .8s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1),
        opacity .2s ease-out,
        border-radius .8s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1);
    }
    body.layout-liquid .settings-overlay { align-items: flex-start; }

    /* Contents drift in one after another once the window is growing. */
    .settings-dialog > * {
      opacity: 0;
      translate: 0 14px;
      transition-property: opacity, translate, transform, border-color, background, box-shadow;
      transition-duration: .2s, .3s, .25s, .25s, .25s, .25s;
      transition-delay: 0s, 0s, 0s, 0s, 0s, 0s;
      transition-timing-function: ease, ease, ease, ease, ease, ease;
    }
    .settings-overlay.open .settings-dialog > * {
      opacity: 1;
      translate: 0 0;
      transition-duration: .45s, .7s, .25s, .25s, .25s, .25s;
      transition-timing-function: ease, cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), ease, ease, ease, ease;
      transition-delay:
        calc(.14s + var(--k, 0) * 50ms),
        calc(.14s + var(--k, 0) * 50ms),
        0s, 0s, 0s, 0s;
    }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(1) { --k: 0; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(2) { --k: 1; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(3) { --k: 2; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(4) { --k: 3; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(5) { --k: 4; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(6) { --k: 5; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(7) { --k: 6; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(8) { --k: 7; }
    .settings-dialog > :nth-child(9) { --k: 8; }
    .layout-option:active { transform: scale(.985); transition-duration: .08s; }
    .settings-close {
      transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22, 1, .36, 1), background .25s ease;
    }
    .settings-close:hover { transform: rotate(90deg); }

    /* ===== Settings tabs + Panic Key section ===== */
    .settings-tabs {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 10px 0 4px;
    }
    .settings-tab {
      flex: 1 1 0;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px solid #523116;
      border-radius: 11px;
      color: var(--white);
      background: #171411;
      transition: background .25s ease, color .25s ease, border-color .25s ease, transform .2s ease;
    }
    .settings-tab:hover {
      border-color: #ffad42;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    .settings-tab.active {
      color: #301a0e;
      font-weight: bold;
      border-color: var(--orange-light);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--orange-light), var(--orange));
    }
    .settings-panel {
      display: none;
    }
    .settings-panel.active {
      display: block;
      animation: appear .35s ease;
    }
    .panic-label {
      margin-top: 14px;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .panic-key-button {
      margin-top: 6px;
    }
    .panic-key-button strong {
      font-size: 20px;
    }
    .panic-key-button.capturing {
      border: 2px dashed #ff9b2f;
    }
    .panic-toggle {
      margin-top: 14px;
    }
    .panic-note {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.5;
      margin: 4px 0 0;
    }
    body.layout-imac .settings-tab {
      border-color: #674c35;
      background: #271c12;
    }
    body.layout-imac .settings-tab.active {
      color: #2a1d11;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fee0c6, #fcbd86);
    }
    body.layout-moonlight .settings-tab.active {
      color: #1f0e0f;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fde2de, #f99e90);
    }
    body.layout-liquid button.settings-tab.active:not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close) {
      color: #ffffff !important;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          155deg,
          rgba(252, 199, 153, .55),
          rgba(228, 155, 92, .48) 50%,
          rgba(230, 138, 124, .45)) !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid button.settings-tab:not(.active):not(.nav-button):not(.settings-launcher):not(.settings-close) {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08) !important;
      color: #fff7f0 !important;
    }
    body.layout-liquid .panic-key-button.capturing {
      border-style: dashed !important;
    }

    /* ===== Theme 6: Schoology (light LMS dashboard look) ===== */
    body.layout-schoology,
    body.layout-schoology * {
      font-family: Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    }
    body.layout-schoology {
      color: #333;
      background: #ebebeb;
    }
    body.layout-schoology #fallLeaves {
      display: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .topbar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto minmax(0, 1fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 0 28px;
      min-height: 60px;
      background: #fff;
      border-bottom: 0;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .brand {
      flex: 0 0 auto;
      margin: 0;
      text-align: left;
      font-size: 19px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #333;
      text-shadow: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .brand span {
      color: #1c75bc;
    }
    body.layout-schoology nav {
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 2px;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .nav-button {
      min-height: 0 !important;
      height: auto !important;
      padding: 20px 14px !important;
      border: 0;
      border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
      border-radius: 0 !important;
      color: #444;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 14px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transform: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .nav-button:hover {
      color: #1c75bc;
      background: #f3f6f9;
      border-color: transparent;
      transform: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .nav-button.active {
      color: #1c75bc;
      background: transparent;
      border-bottom-color: #1c75bc;
      font-weight: 500;
      transform: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology main {
      max-width: 1180px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 370px;
      gap: 0 34px;
      align-items: start;
      padding-top: 30px;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .page {
      grid-column: 1;
      grid-row: 1;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .hero {
      text-align: left;
      padding: 30px 28px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 2px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 34px);
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #333;
      text-shadow: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .hero p {
      margin: 0 0 18px;
      color: #555;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .hero .button-row {
      justify-content: flex-start !important;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .section-title {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #333;
      padding-bottom: 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd2d6;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .section-description {
      color: #666;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .grid {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(270px, 1fr));
      gap: 26px;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .card {
      padding: 16px;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 2px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .card:hover {
      transform: none;
      border-color: transparent;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, .24);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .card > img {
      width: calc(100% + 32px);
      margin: -16px -16px 12px;
      border-radius: 0;
      background: #f1f1f1;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .card:hover > img {
      filter: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .card h3 {
      margin: 0 0 6px;
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #333;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .card p {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #666;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .announcement-date {
      color: #1c75bc;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .button {
      padding: 9px 16px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      color: #fff;
      background: #1c75bc;
      font-weight: 500;
      box-shadow: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .button:hover {
      transform: none;
      filter: brightness(1.12);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .button.secondary {
      color: #333;
      border: 1px solid #c4c8cc;
      background: #f3f4f5;
    }
    body.layout-schoology label {
      color: #1c75bc;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .field {
      color: #333;
      background: #fff;
      border-color: #bfc4c9;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .field:focus {
      border-color: #1c75bc;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #1c75bc33;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .status {
      color: #555;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .footer {
      color: #777;
      border-top: 1px solid #cfd2d6;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-launcher {
      color: #333;
      border: 1px solid #c4c8cc;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, .25);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-overlay.open {
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .45);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-dialog {
      color: #333;
      border: 1px solid #c4c8cc;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, .4);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-heading h2,
    body.layout-schoology .layout-option strong {
      color: #1c75bc;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-intro,
    body.layout-schoology .layout-option span,
    body.layout-schoology .panic-note {
      color: #666;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-close {
      color: #333;
      border-color: #c4c8cc;
      background: #fff;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .layout-option {
      color: #333;
      border-color: #d5d8dc;
      background: #f5f6f7;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .layout-option:hover {
      border-color: #1c75bc;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .layout-option.selected {
      border: 2px solid #1c75bc;
      background: #e6f1fa;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-tab {
      color: #333;
      border-color: #d5d8dc;
      background: #f5f6f7;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .settings-tab.active {
      color: #fff;
      border-color: #1c75bc;
      background: #1c75bc;
    }
    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      body.layout-schoology .topbar {
        display: block;
        padding: 12px 10px 0;
      }
      body.layout-schoology .brand {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 6px;
      }
      body.layout-schoology nav {
        justify-content: center;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
      body.layout-schoology .nav-button {
        padding: 12px 10px !important;
      }
    }

    /* Schoology theme: "User • ONLINE" chip and the right-hand To Do side panel */
    .sg-user,
    .sg-side {
      display: none;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-user {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 10px;
      color: #333;
      font-size: 14px;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-avatar {
      width: 30px;
      height: 30px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #5fb4f0, #1c75bc 70%);
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, .5);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-user b {
      color: #2e9e5b;
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-side {
      display: block;
      grid-column: 2;
      grid-row: 1;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-card {
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      background: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, .16);
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-head {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      padding-bottom: 6px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd2d6;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 16px;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #333;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-link {
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      color: #1c75bc;
      font-size: 12px;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-link:hover {
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-sub {
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: 12px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #555;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      padding: 0;
      border: 0;
      background: none;
      text-align: left;
      color: #555;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-icon {
      flex: 0 0 13px;
      height: 15px;
      margin-top: 2px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: #1aa28c;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-item b {
      display: block;
      color: #1c75bc;
      font-weight: 400;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-item:hover b {
      text-decoration: underline;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-item i {
      display: block;
      font-style: normal;
    }
    body.layout-schoology .sg-empty {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #666;
    }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      body.layout-schoology main {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
      }
      body.layout-schoology .sg-side {
        grid-column: 1;
        grid-row: 2;
        margin-top: 24px;
      }
    }
    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      body.layout-schoology .sg-user {
        justify-content: center;
        padding: 0 0 10px;
      }
    }

    .sg-done {
      list-style: none;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .sg-done li {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 10px;
      margin: 0 0 10px;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      color: #333;
    }
    .sg-done li::before {
      content: "✓";
      flex: 0 0 13px;
      height: 15px;
      margin-top: 1px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: #1aa28c;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 10px;
      line-height: 15px;
      text-align: center;
    }


    /* =====================================================================
       GENIE: the settings window is sliced into thin strips that bend, fold
       and funnel into / out of the gear button (like a Mac minimizing).
       ===================================================================== */
    .genie-layer {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      z-index: 1002;
      pointer-events: none;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .genie-strip {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transform-origin: 0 0;
      will-change: transform, opacity;
      contain: strict;
    }
    .genie-strip > .settings-dialog {
      position: absolute !important;
      left: 0 !important;
      margin: 0 !important;
      transform: none !important;
      translate: none !important;
      opacity: 1 !important;
      visibility: visible !important;
      max-height: none !important;
      box-sizing: border-box !important;
      border-radius: 22px !important;
    }
    /* Flying copies keep the real window's look (sheen, highlights, glows) so nothing
       pops in or out when the real window takes over from the strips. Only things that
       move or cost a lot every frame are switched off: transitions, animations, backdrop blur. */
    .genie-strip,
    .genie-strip * {
      transition: none !important;
      animation: none !important;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
      backdrop-filter: none !important;
      will-change: auto !important;
    }
    .genie-strip { will-change: transform, opacity !important; }
    .genie-strip > .settings-dialog > * { opacity: 1 !important; translate: none !important; }

    /* While the genie plays, the real window waits invisibly in its final pose. */
    .settings-overlay.genie-playing .settings-dialog {
      visibility: hidden !important;
      transform: none !important;
      transition: none !important;
    }
    .settings-overlay.genie-playing .settings-dialog > * { transition: none !important; }

    /* Big blurs are what make weaker computers (Chromebooks) stutter, so the backdrop is a plain dim. */
    .settings-overlay,
    .settings-overlay.open {
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
      backdrop-filter: none !important;
    }
    .settings-overlay.open { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .62); }
    body.layout-liquid .settings-dialog {
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
      backdrop-filter: none !important;
    }
    /* Pause the falling leaves while the window moves, so the browser only has one thing to draw. */
    body.genie-busy .fall-leaf { animation-play-state: paused !important; }


    /* =====================================================================
       THANKSGIVING LOOK for Classic, Harvest Sidebar, Bottom Dock and Top Bar.
       Warm chestnut browns, cranberry, harvest gold, pumpkin and olive, with
       cream text, instead of near-black with neon orange. (Cozy Cabin, iMac,
       Liquid Glass and Schoology keep their own looks.)
       ===================================================================== */
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) {
      --orange: #d9822b;
      --orange-light: #f2c35f;
      --black: #2a1810;
      --panel: #4d2619;
      --panel-light: #5f3120;
      --white: #fbf1dc;
      --muted: #dcc8a8;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at top, #6e3d1c 0%, transparent 52%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 100%, #5c2230 0%, transparent 48%),
        linear-gradient(160deg, #2b1a11, #361d14 55%, #2a1710);
    }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) .topbar {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #512a1b, #3a1d13);
      border-bottom: 0;
      box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(20, 8, 4, .55);
    }
    /* A little woven "harvest ribbon" along the edge of the bar. */
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) .topbar::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      height: 5px;
      pointer-events: none;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #9b2f3c, #d9822b 25%, #f2c35f 50%, #7d8a3a 75%, #9b2f3c);
    }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)).layout-sidebar .topbar {
      border-right: 0;
      box-shadow: 6px 0 22px rgba(20, 8, 4, .55);
    }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)).layout-sidebar .topbar::after {
      left: auto;
      top: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 5px;
      height: auto;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, #9b2f3c, #d9822b 25%, #f2c35f 50%, #7d8a3a 75%, #9b2f3c);
    }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) .brand {
      color: #f2c35f;
      text-shadow: 0 2px 0 #6b2f1c, 0 0 18px rgba(242, 195, 95, .25);
    }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) .brand span { color: #fbf1dc; }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) .brand::after { content: " 🍂"; }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)).layout-sidebar .brand::after { content: ""; }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) .nav-button {
      color: #fbf1dc;
      background: #5d2f1f;
      border-color: #8a5234;
    }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) .nav-button:hover,
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)) .nav-button.active {
      color: #3a1c13;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f6cf74, #d9822b);
      border-color: #f2c35f;
    }
    body:not(.layout-moonlight):not(.layout-schoology):not(.layout-imac):not(.layout-liquid):not(.layout-finder):not(.layout-space):not(:is(.layout-minecraft,.layout-zelda,.layout-roblox,.layout-fortnite,.layout-ios)).layout-bottom nav {

    /* =====================================================================
       COLOR THEMES: every "p-..." theme in the settings list uses the page layouts
       above (classic, sidebar, bottom dock, top bar) and just swaps in its own
       palette through these variables (set by applyPalette in the script).
       ===================================================================== */
    @keyframes leafRise {
      0%   { transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
      50%  { transform: translate3d(35px, -60vh, 0) rotate(160deg); }
      100% { transform: translate3d(-30px, -125vh, 0) rotate(330deg); }
    }
    body.pal-rise .fall-leaf { top: auto; bottom: -10vh; animation-name: leafRise; }
