      color: #fff;
      font-size: 19px;
      background: linear-gradient(#00000099, #00000099), var(--mc-dirt);
      background-size: auto, 64px 64px;
      image-rendering: pixelated;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft,
    body.layout-minecraft * {
      font-family: "Press Start 2P", "VT323", "Minecraftia", "Courier New", monospace !important;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: none;
      font-smooth: never;
      text-rendering: optimizeSpeed;
      border-radius: 0 !important;
      letter-spacing: 0;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft p,
    body.layout-minecraft span,
    body.layout-minecraft label,
    body.layout-minecraft .section-description,
    body.layout-minecraft .gs-meta,
    body.layout-minecraft .footer,
    body.layout-minecraft input,
    body.layout-minecraft textarea { font-family: "VT323", "Press Start 2P", "Courier New", monospace !important; font-size: 1.22em; }
    body.layout-minecraft #fallLeaves,
    body.layout-minecraft .sg-user { display: none !important; }
    body.layout-minecraft .brand-emoji { font-size: 0; }
    body.layout-minecraft .brand-emoji::before { content: "⛏️"; font-size: clamp(22px, 3.5vw, 32px); }

    /* ---- header: oak planks with a grass edge ---- */
    body.layout-minecraft .topbar {
      background: var(--mc-planks);
      background-size: 64px 64px;
      border-bottom: 8px solid #5d9b3b;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #866043, 0 12px 0 #00000066;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .brand {
      position: relative;
      color: #3b2a14;
      font-size: clamp(18px, 3vw, 30px);
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .brand span { color: #2f5f18; font-family: "Press Start 2P", "Courier New", monospace !important; font-size: 1em; }
    body.layout-minecraft .brand-emoji { font-size: 0 !important; }
    body.layout-minecraft .brand::after {
      content: "Now with blocks!";
      position: absolute;
      right: 6%;
      bottom: -14px;
      color: #ffff00;
      font-size: 12px;
      transform: rotate(-14deg);
      animation: mcSplash .6s steps(2, end) infinite alternate;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    @keyframes mcSplash { from { scale: 1; } to { scale: 1.12; } }
    @media (max-width: 760px) { body.layout-minecraft .brand::after { display: none; } }

    /* ---- stone buttons ---- */
    body.layout-minecraft .nav-button,
    body.layout-minecraft .button,
    body.layout-minecraft .button.secondary,
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-tab,
    body.layout-minecraft .layout-option,
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-close {
      color: #fff;
      background: var(--mc-stone);
      background-size: 48px 48px;
      border: 0;
      box-shadow: inset -4px -4px 0 #00000066, inset 4px 4px 0 #ffffff55, 0 0 0 3px #000;
      margin-top: 3px;
      font-weight: normal;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 12px 16px;
      transition: none !important;
      transform: none;
      filter: none;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .layout-option { margin-top: 14px; }
    body.layout-minecraft .nav-button:hover,
    body.layout-minecraft .button:hover,
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-tab:hover,
    body.layout-minecraft .layout-option:hover,
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-close:hover {
      color: #ffffa0;
      background: #6c7bc0;
      box-shadow: inset -4px -4px 0 #00000066, inset 4px 4px 0 #ffffff66, 0 0 0 3px #000;
      transform: none;
      filter: none;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .nav-button:active,
    body.layout-minecraft .button:active { box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 0 #00000066, inset -4px -4px 0 #ffffff33, 0 0 0 3px #000; }
    body.layout-minecraft .nav-button.active,
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-tab.active,
    body.layout-minecraft .layout-option.selected {
      color: #ffff55;
      background: #5d9b3b;
      border: 0;
      box-shadow: inset -4px -4px 0 #00000066, inset 4px 4px 0 #ffffff66, 0 0 0 3px #000;
      transform: none;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .layout-option strong { color: #fff; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }
    body.layout-minecraft .layout-option span { color: #e0e0e0; font-size: 1.1em; }
    body.layout-minecraft .layout-option.selected strong { color: #ffff55; }

    /* ---- text ---- */
    body.layout-minecraft .section-title,
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-heading h2 {
      color: #fff;
      font-size: clamp(16px, 2.6vw, 24px);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .section-description,
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-intro,
    body.layout-minecraft .gs-meta { color: #e6e6e6; line-height: 1.3; }
    body.layout-minecraft .gs-meta b { color: #ffff55; }
    body.layout-minecraft .footer { color: #bdbdbd; border-top: 4px solid #00000066; }
    body.layout-minecraft label { color: #fff; }
    body.layout-minecraft .announcement-date { color: #ffaa00; }

    /* ---- oak-sign hero ---- */
    body.layout-minecraft .hero {
      background: var(--mc-planks);
      background-size: 64px 64px;
      border: 0;
      box-shadow: inset -6px -6px 0 #00000055, inset 6px 6px 0 #ffffff44, 0 0 0 4px #000, 0 10px 0 4px #00000055;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .hero h1 {
      color: #3b2a14;
      font-size: clamp(20px, 4.4vw, 40px);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .hero p { color: #2b1b0a; font-size: 1.35em; }

    /* ---- inventory-GUI cards ---- */
    body.layout-minecraft .card,
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-dialog,
    body.layout-minecraft .suggestion-card,
    body.layout-minecraft .announcement {
      color: #3f3f3f;
      background: #c6c6c6;
      border: 0;
      box-shadow: inset 4px 4px 0 #fff, inset -4px -4px 0 #555, 0 0 0 4px #000, 0 10px 0 4px #00000055;
      animation: none;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .card:hover { transform: none; filter: brightness(1.06); }
    body.layout-minecraft .card h3 { color: #3f3f3f; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
    body.layout-minecraft .card p { color: #4a4a4a; font-size: 1.3em; line-height: 1.25; }
    body.layout-minecraft .grid { gap: 26px; }
    body.layout-minecraft .gаmе-image {
      image-rendering: pixelated;
      background: #373737;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px #373737, 0 4px 0 #555;
      border: 4px solid #373737;
      margin: -20px -20px 14px;
      width: calc(100% + 40px);
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-dialog { padding: 26px; }
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-heading h2 { color: #3f3f3f; }
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-intro { color: #4a4a4a; }
    body.layout-minecraft .panic-note,
    body.layout-minecraft .panic-label { color: #4a4a4a; }
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-overlay { background: #000000aa; backdrop-filter: none; }

    /* ---- text boxes ---- */
    body.layout-minecraft .field,
    body.layout-minecraft input,
    body.layout-minecraft textarea,
    body.layout-minecraft select {
      color: #e0e0e0;
      background: #000;
      border: 3px solid #a0a0a0;
      box-shadow: none;
      transform: none;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .field:focus,
    body.layout-minecraft .field.game-search:focus-within { border-color: #fff; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }
    body.layout-minecraft .game-search input.gs-input { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #e0e0e0; }
    body.layout-minecraft .game-search .gs-icon { color: #a0a0a0; }
    body.layout-minecraft .game-search .gs-kbd,
    body.layout-minecraft .game-search .gs-clear { color: #fff; background: #555; border: 2px solid #a0a0a0; }

    /* ---- gear button: a little stone block ---- */
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-launcher {
      color: #fff;
      background: var(--mc-stone);
      background-size: 48px 48px;
      border: 0;
      box-shadow: inset -4px -4px 0 #00000066, inset 4px 4px 0 #ffffff55, 0 0 0 3px #000, 0 6px 0 3px #00000066;
    }
    body.layout-minecraft .settings-launcher:hover { transform: none; background: #6c7bc0; }

    /* ---- chunky square scrollbars ---- */
    body.layout-minecraft ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
    body.layout-minecraft ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #000; }
    body.layout-minecraft ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #8b8b8b; box-shadow: inset -3px -3px 0 #555, inset 3px 3px 0 #fff; }
    body.layout-minecraft ::selection { background: #5d9b3b; color: #fff; }
      body.layout-minecraft, body.layout-minecraft *, body.layout-minecraft *::before, body.layout-minecraft *::after { text-shadow: none !important; }

    /* =====================================================================
       ZELDA THEME (Breath of the Wild) - Sheikah Slate UI: dark slate panels,
       glowing cyan lines, parchment hero, gold Triforce, Hylia Serif text.
       Everything below only applies when <body> has the class layout-zelda.
       ===================================================================== */
    @font-face { font-family: "Hylia Serif"; src: local("Hylia Serif"), local("Hylia Serif Beta"), local("HyliaSerifBeta-Regular"), local("HyliaSerif-Regular"); }
    body.layout-zelda {
      --orange: #4ed8f5;
      --orange-light: #f0d98a;
      --black: #0b161b;
      --panel: #16242b;
      --panel-light: #1d3a43;
      --white: #f4efe0;
      --muted: #b4c8c8;
      --zl-cyan: #4ed8f5;
      --zl-cyan2: #8ff0ff;
      --zl-line: #3a6f7a;
      --zl-chamfer: polygon(10px 0, calc(100% - 10px) 0, 100% 10px, 100% calc(100% - 10px), calc(100% - 10px) 100%, 10px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 10px), 0 10px);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 18px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -10%, #2a6571 0%, transparent 55%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #0c1a20, #112830 60%, #0d1e24);
    }
    body.layout-zelda, body.layout-zelda * { font-family: "Hylia Serif","Hylia Serif Beta","HyliaSerifBeta-Regular","Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif !important; }
    body.layout-zelda .brand, body.layout-zelda h1, body.layout-zelda h2, body.layout-zelda h3,
    body.layout-zelda .nav-button, body.layout-zelda .button, body.layout-zelda .settings-tab,
    body.layout-zelda .layout-option strong, body.layout-zelda .section-title { font-family: "Hylia Serif","Hylia Serif Beta","HyliaSerifBeta-Regular","Cinzel",Georgia,serif !important; }
    body.layout-zelda p, body.layout-zelda .section-description, body.layout-zelda .layout-option span { font-size: 1.12em; }
    body.layout-zelda #fallLeaves, body.layout-zelda .sg-user { display: none !important; }
    body.layout-zelda .brand-emoji { font-size: 0 !important; }
    body.layout-zelda .brand-emoji::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 1.1em; height: 1em; font-size: clamp(25px, 4vw, 38px); vertical-align: -.1em; background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 viewBox=%220 0 32 28%22%3E%3Cg fill=%22%23f0c75e%22 stroke=%22%237a5a12%22 stroke-width=%221%22 stroke-linejoin=%22round%22%3E%3Cpath d=%22M16 1L23 13H9z%22/%3E%3Cpath d=%22M9 15L16 27H2z%22/%3E%3Cpath d=%22M23 15L30 27H16z%22/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E") center / contain no-repeat; }

    /* ---- header: Sheikah slate bar ---- */
    body.layout-zelda .topbar {
      background: #0f1d23f2;
      border-bottom: 2px solid var(--zl-cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 0 22px #4ed8f544, 0 4px 18px #000000aa;
    }
    body.layout-zelda .brand { color: var(--white); letter-spacing: .14em; text-shadow: none; }
    body.layout-zelda .brand span { color: #f0c75e; }
    body.layout-zelda .nav-button, body.layout-zelda .button, body.layout-zelda .settings-tab {
      color: #e8fbff;
      background: #14282f;
      border: 1px solid var(--zl-cyan);
      border-radius: 3px;
      letter-spacing: .06em;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px #4ed8f522;
      clip-path: var(--zl-chamfer);
      transition: background .2s, color .2s, box-shadow .2s;
      transform: none;
      filter: none;
    }
    body.layout-zelda .nav-button:hover, body.layout-zelda .button:hover, body.layout-zelda .settings-tab:hover {
      color: #fff; background: #1f4a55; box-shadow: inset 0 0 16px #4ed8f566; transform: none; filter: none;
    }
    body.layout-zelda .nav-button.active, body.layout-zelda .settings-tab.active {
      color: #0b161b; background: var(--zl-cyan); font-weight: bold; border-color: var(--zl-cyan2); transform: none;
    }
    body.layout-zelda .button.secondary { color: #f4e7b8; border-color: #d9b95b; background: #2a2616; box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px #d9b95b22; }
    body.layout-zelda .button.secondary:hover { background: #4a4020; }

    /* ---- headings and text ---- */
    body.layout-zelda .section-title {
      color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      padding-bottom: 10px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #4ed8f566;
      text-shadow: none;
    }
    body.layout-zelda .section-description { color: var(--muted); }
    body.layout-zelda .footer { color: #8fa9a9; border-top: 1px solid #3a6f7a88; }
    body.layout-zelda label, body.layout-zelda .gs-meta b { color: var(--zl-cyan2); }
    body.layout-zelda .announcement-date { color: var(--zl-cyan2); }

    /* ---- parchment hero with a faint Sheikah eye ---- */
    body.layout-zelda .hero {
      position: relative;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #f4ecd2, #e2d4aa);
      border: 3px double #8a6b3c;
      border-radius: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #00000055, 0 12px 34px #000000aa, inset 0 0 40px #b8955a55;
    }
    body.layout-zelda .hero::after {
      content: ""; position: absolute; top: 14px; right: 18px; width: 86px; height: 55px;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 viewBox=%220 0 100 64%22%3E%3Cg fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22%233a2d1a%22 stroke-width=%223%22 stroke-linecap=%22round%22 stroke-linejoin=%22round%22%3E%3Cpath d=%22M4 32Q50 -6 96 32Q50 70 4 32z%22/%3E%3Ccircle cx=%2250%22 cy=%2232%22 r=%2211%22/%3E%3Cpath d=%22M50 3V20M50 44Q43 54 50 61Q57 54 50 44z%22/%3E%3C/g%3E%3Ccircle cx=%2250%22 cy=%2232%22 r=%223.5%22 fill=%22%233a2d1a%22/%3E%3C/svg%3E") center / contain no-repeat; opacity: .28; pointer-events: none;
    }
    body.layout-zelda .hero h1 { color: #3a2d1a; letter-spacing: .06em; text-shadow: none; }
    body.layout-zelda .hero p { color: #4a3b24; }

    /* ---- Sheikah slate cards ---- */
    body.layout-zelda .card, body.layout-zelda .settings-dialog, body.layout-zelda .suggestion-card, body.layout-zelda .announcement {
      color: var(--white);
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1b323a, #11222a);
      border: 1px solid var(--zl-line);
      border-radius: 6px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #0e1a20, inset 0 0 0 4px #2d5a65, 0 8px 22px #00000077;
      transition: box-shadow .25s, border-color .25s;
    }
    body.layout-zelda .card:hover { transform: none; border-color: var(--zl-cyan); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #0e1a20, inset 0 0 0 4px var(--zl-cyan), 0 0 18px #4ed8f566, 0 8px 22px #00000077; }
    body.layout-zelda .card h3 { color: #f0d98a; letter-spacing: .05em; }
    body.layout-zelda .card p { color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.5; }
    body.layout-zelda .gаmе-image { border-radius: 5px 5px 0 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--zl-cyan); background: #0e1a20; }
    body.layout-zelda .settings-dialog { border-color: var(--zl-cyan); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #0e1a20, inset 0 0 0 4px #2d5a65, 0 0 30px #4ed8f544, 0 18px 60px #000000cc; }
    body.layout-zelda .settings-heading h2 { color: #f0d98a; letter-spacing: .06em; }
    body.layout-zelda .settings-intro, body.layout-zelda .panic-note, body.layout-zelda .panic-label { color: var(--muted); }
    body.layout-zelda .layout-option { color: var(--white); background: #14282f; border: 1px solid var(--zl-line); border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color .2s, background .2s; }
    body.layout-zelda .layout-option:hover { border-color: var(--zl-cyan); transform: none; }
    body.layout-zelda .layout-option strong { color: #f0d98a; }
    body.layout-zelda .layout-option.selected { border: 1px solid var(--zl-cyan); background: #1d3a43; box-shadow: 0 0 14px #4ed8f544, inset 0 0 12px #4ed8f522; }
    body.layout-zelda .layout-option.selected strong { color: var(--zl-cyan2); }
    body.layout-zelda .settings-close { color: #e8fbff; background: #14282f; border: 1px solid var(--zl-cyan); border-radius: 3px; }
    body.layout-zelda .settings-overlay { background: #050d11cc; }

    /* ---- text boxes ---- */
    body.layout-zelda .field, body.layout-zelda input, body.layout-zelda textarea, body.layout-zelda select {
      color: var(--white); background: #0c171c; border: 1px solid var(--zl-line); border-radius: 4px;
    }
    body.layout-zelda .field:focus, body.layout-zelda .field.game-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--zl-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #4ed8f544, 0 0 14px #4ed8f544; }
    body.layout-zelda .game-search input.gs-input { border: 0; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }
    body.layout-zelda .game-search .gs-icon { color: var(--zl-cyan); }
    body.layout-zelda .game-search .gs-kbd, body.layout-zelda .game-search .gs-clear { color: var(--zl-cyan2); border-color: var(--zl-line); background: #14282f; }

    /* ---- gear button: glowing Sheikah ring ---- */
    body.layout-zelda .settings-launcher { background: #12222a; border: 2px solid var(--zl-cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 18px #4ed8f588, inset 0 0 10px #4ed8f544; }
    body.layout-zelda ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; height: 10px; }
    body.layout-zelda ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #0c171c; }
    body.layout-zelda ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #2d6b78; border-radius: 5px; }
    body.layout-zelda ::selection { background: #4ed8f5; color: #0b161b; }

    /* =====================================================================
       ROBLOX THEME - light website layout: slim top bar, icon sidebar on the left,
       big page titles, thumbnail tiles with the title underneath.
       Everything below only applies when <body> has the class layout-roblox.
       ===================================================================== */
    body.layout-roblox {
      --orange: #335fff; --orange-light: #335fff; --black: #232527;
      --panel: #fff; --panel-light: #f2f4f5; --white: #232527; --muted: #606162;
      color: #232527; background: #fff; font-size: 16px;
    }
    body.layout-roblox, body.layout-roblox * {
      font-family: "Builder Sans", "Gotham SSm", "Segoe UI", Roboto, system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important;
    }
    body.layout-roblox #fallLeaves, body.layout-roblox .liquid-dock-lens { display: none !important; }

    /* ---- top bar ---- */
    body.layout-roblox .topbar {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 50; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
      background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e5e7; box-shadow: none; animation: none;
    }
    body.layout-roblox .topbar::after { display: none !important; }
    body.layout-roblox .brand {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 0; text-align: left;
      font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .02em; color: #232527; text-shadow: none;
    }
    body.layout-roblox .brand span { color: #232527; }
    body.layout-roblox .brand-emoji { font-size: 0 !important; }
    body.layout-roblox .brand-emoji::before {
      content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 4px; transform: rotate(12deg);
      background: linear-gradient(#fff, #fff) center / 6px 6px no-repeat, #232527;
    }
    body.layout-roblox .sg-user { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-left: auto; color: #232527; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; }
    body.layout-roblox .sg-avatar { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%, #dfe1e4, #a9acb0); }
    body.layout-roblox .sg-user > span:last-child { font-size: 0; }
    body.layout-roblox .sg-user > span:last-child::after { content: "Player"; font-size: 14px; }

    /* ---- left sidebar ---- */
    body.layout-roblox nav {
      position: fixed; top: 48px; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 240px; z-index: 40;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex-wrap: nowrap; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 2px;
      padding: 12px 14px; background: #fff; overflow-y: auto;
    }
    body.layout-roblox .nav-button {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; text-align: left;
      color: #232527; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: none;
      font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; transform: none; filter: none; transition: background .15s;
    }
    body.layout-roblox .nav-button::before { width: 24px; font-size: 20px; text-align: center; filter: grayscale(1); }
    body.layout-roblox nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(1)::before { content: "🏠"; }
    body.layout-roblox nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(2)::before { content: "📢"; }
    body.layout-roblox nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(3)::before { content: "🎮"; }
    body.layout-roblox nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(4)::before { content: "💬"; }
    body.layout-roblox nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(5)::before { content: "ℹ️"; }
    body.layout-roblox nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(6)::before { content: "💡"; }
    body.layout-roblox .nav-button:hover { color: #232527; background: #f2f4f5; transform: none; border: 0; }
    body.layout-roblox .nav-button.active { color: #232527; background: #e3e5e7; border: 0; transform: none; }

    /* ---- page area ---- */
    body.layout-roblox main { max-width: none; margin: 0 0 0 240px; padding: 72px 32px 60px; }
    body.layout-roblox .footer { margin-left: 240px; color: #8a8c8e; border-top: 1px solid #e3e5e7; }
    body.layout-roblox .section-title, body.layout-roblox .hero h1 {
      margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 800; color: #232527; text-shadow: none; letter-spacing: 0;
    }
    body.layout-roblox .section-description, body.layout-roblox .hero p { color: #606162; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 760px; margin: 0 0 18px; }
    body.layout-roblox .hero { text-align: left; padding: 0 0 8px; background: none; border: 0; box-shadow: none; border-radius: 0; }
    body.layout-roblox .hero .button-row { justify-content: flex-start !important; }
    body.layout-roblox .announcement-date { color: #606162; font-size: 13px; }
    body.layout-roblox label { color: #232527; font-weight: 600; }
    body.layout-roblox .gs-meta { color: #606162; }
    body.layout-roblox .gs-meta b { color: #232527; }

    /* ---- buttons ---- */
    body.layout-roblox .button {
      color: #fff; background: #335fff; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 18px;
      font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; transform: none; filter: none; transition: background .15s;
    }
    body.layout-roblox .button:hover { background: #2a50dd; transform: none; filter: none; }
    body.layout-roblox .button.secondary { color: #232527; background: #e3e5e7; border: 0; }
    body.layout-roblox .button.secondary:hover { background: #d4d6d9; }

    /* ---- tiles ---- */
    body.layout-roblox .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 20px 14px; }
    body.layout-roblox .card, body.layout-roblox .suggestion-card, body.layout-roblox .announcement {
      padding: 16px; color: #232527; background: #f2f4f5; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: none; animation: none;
    }
    body.layout-roblox .card:hover { transform: none; filter: none; }
    body.layout-roblox .card:has(.gаmе-image) { padding: 0; background: transparent; }
    body.layout-roblox .gаmе-image { width: 100%; margin: 0 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #e3e5e7; }
    body.layout-roblox .card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #232527; }
    body.layout-roblox .card p { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; color: #606162; }
    body.layout-roblox .card:has(.gаmе-image) p { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }
    body.layout-roblox .card:has(.gаmе-image) .button { background: #00b06f; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 14px; }
    body.layout-roblox .card:has(.gаmе-image) .button:hover { background: #009a60; }

    /* ---- inputs and search ---- */
    body.layout-roblox .field, body.layout-roblox input, body.layout-roblox textarea, body.layout-roblox select {
      color: #232527; background: #f2f4f5; border: 1px solid #e3e5e7; border-radius: 8px;
    }
    body.layout-roblox .field:focus, body.layout-roblox .field.game-search:focus-within { border-color: #232527; box-shadow: none; transform: none; }
    body.layout-roblox .field.game-search { height: 42px; border-radius: 21px; }
    body.layout-roblox .game-search input.gs-input { border: 0; background: transparent; }
    body.layout-roblox .game-search .gs-icon { color: #606162; }
    body.layout-roblox .game-search .gs-kbd, body.layout-roblox .game-search .gs-clear { color: #606162; background: #e3e5e7; border-color: #d4d6d9; }

    /* ---- settings ---- */
    body.layout-roblox .settings-overlay { background: #00000080; backdrop-filter: none; }
    body.layout-roblox .settings-dialog { color: #232527; background: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 40px #0000004d; }
    body.layout-roblox .settings-heading h2 { color: #232527; font-weight: 800; }
    body.layout-roblox .settings-intro, body.layout-roblox .panic-note, body.layout-roblox .panic-label { color: #606162; }
    body.layout-roblox .settings-tab { color: #232527; background: #f2f4f5; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; transform: none; }
    body.layout-roblox .settings-tab:hover { background: #e3e5e7; transform: none; }
    body.layout-roblox .settings-tab.active { color: #fff; background: #232527; }
    body.layout-roblox .layout-option { color: #232527; background: #f2f4f5; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; }
    body.layout-roblox .layout-option:hover { border-color: #bec0c3; transform: none; }
    body.layout-roblox .layout-option strong { color: #232527; }
    body.layout-roblox .layout-option span { color: #606162; }
    body.layout-roblox .layout-option.selected { border: 2px solid #335fff; background: #eef1ff; }
    body.layout-roblox .settings-close { color: #232527; background: #f2f4f5; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; }
    body.layout-roblox .settings-launcher { color: #232527; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e3e5e7; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px #00000033; }
    body.layout-roblox .settings-launcher:hover { transform: none; background: #f2f4f5; }
    body.layout-roblox ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
    body.layout-roblox ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #c8cacd; border-radius: 4px; }

    @media (max-width: 820px) {
      body.layout-roblox nav { top: auto; right: 0; width: auto; height: 62px; flex-direction: row; justify-content: space-around; padding: 4px 6px; border-top: 1px solid #e3e5e7; }
      body.layout-roblox .nav-button { flex: 1; justify-content: center; gap: 0; padding: 8px 4px; font-size: 0; }
      body.layout-roblox .nav-button::before { font-size: 22px; }
      body.layout-roblox main { margin-left: 0; padding: 68px 16px 90px; }
      body.layout-roblox .footer { margin-left: 0; padding-bottom: 80px; }
      body.layout-roblox .sg-user { display: none; }
      body.layout-roblox .settings-launcher { bottom: 78px; }
    }

    /* =====================================================================
       FORTNITE THEME - lobby look: purple/blue sky gradient, slanted italic
       condensed caps, yellow PLAY buttons, rarity-colored item cards.
       Everything below only applies when <body> has the class layout-fortnite.
       ===================================================================== */
    body.layout-fortnite {
      --orange: #ffe600; --orange-light: #ffe600; --black: #0a0f3c;
      --panel: #1b1464; --panel-light: #2a1f8f; --white: #ffffff; --muted: #c4d8ff;
      --fn-blue: #5aa8ff; --fn-yellow: #ffe600; --fn-navy: #0a0f3c;
      color: #fff; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 12% 0%, #8a46ff88, transparent 55%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 92% 8%, #00c8ff77, transparent 50%),
        repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, #ffffff0a 0 24px, transparent 24px 64px),
        linear-gradient(170deg, #150a4d, #2030b0 55%, #0a6cd8);
    }
    body.layout-fortnite, body.layout-fortnite * { font-family: "Segoe UI",Roboto,"Noto Sans",Arial,sans-serif !important; }
    body.layout-fortnite .brand, body.layout-fortnite h1, body.layout-fortnite h2, body.layout-fortnite h3,
    body.layout-fortnite .nav-button, body.layout-fortnite .button, body.layout-fortnite .settings-tab,
    body.layout-fortnite .layout-option strong, body.layout-fortnite .section-title, body.layout-fortnite .hero::before {
      font-family: "Burbank Big Condensed","Anton","Impact","Haettenschweiler","Arial Narrow",sans-serif !important; font-weight: 700; font-style: italic; font-synthesis-weight: none;
      text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .03em;
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .sg-user { display: none !important; }
    /* falling leaves become falling V-Bucks */
    body.layout-fortnite .fall-leaf { font-size: 0 !important; opacity: .8; }
    body.layout-fortnite .fall-leaf::before { content: "🪙"; font-size: 22px; }
    body.layout-fortnite .brand-emoji { font-size: 0 !important; }
    body.layout-fortnite .brand-emoji::before { content: "🪂"; font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 40px); font-style: normal; }

    /* ---- top bar ---- */
    body.layout-fortnite .topbar {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px 28px;
      padding: 12px 28px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0a0f3cf5, #2a1590f5);
      border-bottom: 4px solid #ffe600; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 #00000040, 0 10px 24px #00000066;
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .topbar::after { display: none !important; }
    body.layout-fortnite .brand { margin: 0; text-align: left; font-size: clamp(26px, 3.4vw, 40px); line-height: 1; color: #fff; text-shadow: none; }
    body.layout-fortnite .brand span { color: #ffe600; }
    body.layout-fortnite nav { flex: 1 1 auto; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; }
    body.layout-fortnite .nav-button {
      padding: 8px 20px; font-size: 20px; color: #ffffffd9; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 0;
      transform: skewX(-10deg); box-shadow: none; transition: background .12s, transform .12s, color .12s; filter: none;
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .nav-button:hover { color: #fff; background: #ffffff33; transform: skewX(-10deg) translateY(-2px); }
    body.layout-fortnite .nav-button.active { color: #1b1464; background: #fff; transform: skewX(-10deg); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #ffe600; }

    /* ---- main buttons: yellow PLAY style ---- */
    body.layout-fortnite .button {
      color: #000; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff35c, #ffc800); border: 0; border-radius: 0;
      padding: 11px 26px; font-size: 21px; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #00000055;
      transform: skewX(-10deg); transition: transform .12s, box-shadow .12s, filter .12s; filter: none;
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .button:hover { transform: skewX(-10deg) translateY(-3px) scale(1.05); box-shadow: 6px 8px 0 #00000055; filter: brightness(1.12); }
    body.layout-fortnite .button:active { transform: skewX(-10deg) translateY(1px); box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #00000055; }
    body.layout-fortnite .button.secondary { color: #fff; background: #0a0f3ccc; border: 3px solid #fff; padding: 8px 23px; }
    body.layout-fortnite .button.secondary:hover { background: #fff; color: #1b1464; filter: none; }

    /* ---- titles ---- */
    body.layout-fortnite .section-title {
      position: relative; margin: 0 0 18px; padding-bottom: 14px; font-size: clamp(36px, 5.4vw, 60px); line-height: 1; color: #fff; text-shadow: none;
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .section-title::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; width: 110px; height: 7px; background: #ffe600; transform: skewX(-25deg); }
    body.layout-fortnite .section-description { color: #c4d8ff; font-size: 18px; }
    body.layout-fortnite .footer { color: #9fc0ff; border-top: 3px solid #ffffff22; }
    body.layout-fortnite label { color: #ffe600; font-size: 18px; }
    body.layout-fortnite .announcement-date { color: #ffe600; font-weight: 700; }
    body.layout-fortnite .gs-meta { color: #c4d8ff; }
    body.layout-fortnite .gs-meta b { color: #ffe600; }

    /* ---- hero: key-art banner ---- */
    body.layout-fortnite .hero {
      position: relative; padding: 70px 28px 52px; text-align: left; border: 0; border-radius: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 58%, #ffe60022 58% 64%, transparent 64%),
        linear-gradient(125deg, #7a2bff, #2b4bff 55%, #00b7ff);
      clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 34px) 0, 100% 34px, 100% 100%, 34px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 34px));
      box-shadow: none; border-left: 12px solid #ffe600;
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .hero::before {
      content: "#1 Victory Royale"; position: absolute; top: 18px; left: 24px; padding: 4px 18px;
      font-size: 20px; color: #000; background: #ffe600; transform: skewX(-10deg);
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .hero h1 { margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: clamp(42px, 8vw, 92px); line-height: .95; color: #fff; text-shadow: none; }
    body.layout-fortnite .hero p { margin: 0 0 24px; max-width: 640px; color: #fff; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.4; }
    body.layout-fortnite .hero .button-row { justify-content: flex-start !important; }

    /* ---- item-shop cards with rarity colors ---- */
    body.layout-fortnite .grid { gap: 22px; }
    body.layout-fortnite .card, body.layout-fortnite .suggestion-card, body.layout-fortnite .announcement {
      --r1: #b45cf0; --r2: #5a249c; --rb: #e4b4ff;
      position: relative; padding: 0 0 4px; overflow: hidden; color: #fff; border: 3px solid var(--rb); border-radius: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--r1), var(--r2));
      box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #0000004d; animation: none; transition: transform .14s, box-shadow .14s;
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .grid > .card:nth-child(5n+1) { --r1: #ffb02e; --r2: #b4501a; --rb: #ffe08a; }
    body.layout-fortnite .grid > .card:nth-child(5n+2) { --r1: #38b6ff; --r2: #1a56b4; --rb: #a8e0ff; }
    body.layout-fortnite .grid > .card:nth-child(5n+3) { --r1: #b45cf0; --r2: #5a249c; --rb: #e4b4ff; }
    body.layout-fortnite .grid > .card:nth-child(5n+4) { --r1: #7ddf4f; --r2: #2a7a2a; --rb: #c8f5a8; }
    body.layout-fortnite .grid > .card:nth-child(5n+5) { --r1: #8aa0c8; --r2: #44557a; --rb: #d4dff5; }
    body.layout-fortnite .card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.02); filter: none; box-shadow: 0 14px 0 #0000004d, 0 0 24px var(--r1); }
    body.layout-fortnite .card h3 { margin: 0; padding: 10px 14px 4px; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.1; color: #fff; background: #0a0f3cd9; }
    body.layout-fortnite .card p { margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 2px 14px 12px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.35; color: #d8e6ff; background: #0a0f3cd9; }
    body.layout-fortnite .card .announcement-date { padding: 0 14px 2px; background: #0a0f3cd9; }
    body.layout-fortnite .card .button { margin: 4px 14px 10px; padding: 8px 20px; font-size: 18px; }
    body.layout-fortnite .gаmе-image { width: 100%; margin: 0; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border-radius: 0; background: #0a0f3c; border-bottom: 3px solid var(--rb); }

    /* ---- inputs ---- */
    body.layout-fortnite .field, body.layout-fortnite input, body.layout-fortnite textarea, body.layout-fortnite select {
      color: #fff; background: #0a0f3ccc; border: 3px solid #5aa8ff; border-radius: 0;
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .field:focus, body.layout-fortnite .field.game-search:focus-within { border-color: #ffe600; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #ffe60044; transform: none; }
    body.layout-fortnite .game-search input.gs-input { border: 0; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; text-transform: uppercase; }
    body.layout-fortnite .game-search .gs-icon { color: #ffe600; }
    body.layout-fortnite .game-search .gs-kbd, body.layout-fortnite .game-search .gs-clear { color: #000; background: #ffe600; border-color: #000; }

    /* ---- settings ---- */
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-overlay { background: #050830cc; backdrop-filter: none; }
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-dialog {
      color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #2a1f8f, #0f1470); border: 3px solid #5aa8ff; border-radius: 0;
      box-shadow: 0 0 34px #00c8ff55, 8px 8px 0 #0000005e;
    }
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-heading h2 { color: #ffe600; font-size: 34px; }
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-intro, body.layout-fortnite .panic-note, body.layout-fortnite .panic-label { color: #c4d8ff; }
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-tab { color: #ffffffd9; background: #ffffff1f; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-size: 19px; transform: skewX(-10deg); box-shadow: none; }
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-tab:hover { background: #ffffff40; transform: skewX(-10deg); }
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-tab.active { color: #1b1464; background: #fff; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #ffe600; }
    body.layout-fortnite .layout-option { color: #fff; background: #0a0f3ccc; border: 0; border-left: 8px solid #5aa8ff; border-radius: 0; transition: transform .12s, border-color .12s; }
    body.layout-fortnite .layout-option:hover { border-left-color: #fff; transform: translateX(4px); }
    body.layout-fortnite .layout-option strong { color: #fff; font-size: 22px; }
    body.layout-fortnite .layout-option span { color: #c4d8ff; }
    body.layout-fortnite .layout-option.selected { border: 0; border-left: 8px solid #ffe600; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #5b2bd6, #0a0f3ccc); }
    body.layout-fortnite .layout-option.selected strong { color: #ffe600; }
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-close { color: #fff; background: #ff3b5c; border: 0; border-radius: 0; transform: skewX(-10deg); }
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-launcher { color: #000; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff35c, #ffc800); border: 3px solid #000; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #00000066, 0 0 20px #ffe60099; }
    body.layout-fortnite .settings-launcher:hover { transform: rotate(25deg) scale(1.1); }
    body.layout-fortnite ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 12px; height: 12px; }
    body.layout-fortnite ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #0a0f3c; }
    body.layout-fortnite ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #ffe600; border: 2px solid #0a0f3c; }
    body.layout-fortnite ::selection { background: #ffe600; color: #000; }
    @media (max-width: 760px) { body.layout-fortnite .topbar { justify-content: center; } body.layout-fortnite nav { justify-content: center; } }

    /* =====================================================================
       OLD iOS THEME (iPhone OS 1-3) - black glass status bar, blue-steel navigation bar,
       pinstripe background, grouped white tables, glossy app icons in a dock.
       Everything below only applies when <body> has the class layout-ios.
       ===================================================================== */
    body.layout-ios {
      --orange: #2f5bb0; --orange-light: #2f5bb0; --black: #000;
      --panel: #fff; --panel-light: #f1f3f6; --white: #222; --muted: #555;
      --ios-pin: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #c5ccd4 0 5px, #cfd5dc 5px 7px);
      --ios-gloss: linear-gradient(to bottom, #ffffff73 0, #ffffff26 50%, #ffffff00 50%);
      color: #222; font-size: 16px; background: var(--ios-pin);
    }
    body.layout-ios, body.layout-ios * { font-family: "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, "Lucida Grande", sans-serif !important; }
    body.layout-ios #fallLeaves, body.layout-ios .sg-user, body.layout-ios .liquid-dock-lens { display: none !important; }

    /* ---- status bar (carrier, clock, battery) ---- */
    body.layout-ios::before {
      content: var(--ios-time, "9:41 AM"); position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 60; height: 20px;
      line-height: 20px; text-align: center; font-size: 12px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff;
      background: linear-gradient(#4a4a4a, #000 35%, #000); pointer-events: none;
    }
    body.layout-ios::after {
      content: "●●●●○  UGS"; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 8px; z-index: 65; line-height: 20px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff; pointer-events: none;
    }
    body.layout-ios .topbar::before {
      content: "100% 🔋"; position: fixed; top: 0; right: 8px; z-index: 5; line-height: 20px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff; pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* ---- navigation bar (blue steel) ---- */
    body.layout-ios .topbar {
      position: fixed; top: 20px; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 70; height: 44px; padding: 0 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(#b0bdd4 0, #8fa2c0 48%, #7d93b6 50%, #6f87ad 100%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid #2d3642; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff80, 0 1px 3px #0006; animation: none;
    }
    body.layout-ios .topbar::after { display: none !important; }
    body.layout-ios .brand { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 -1px 0 #00000073; }
    body.layout-ios .brand span { color: #fff; }
    body.layout-ios .brand-emoji { font-size: 0 !important; }

    /* ---- dock with glossy app icons ---- */
    body.layout-ios nav {
      position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 70; height: 82px; padding: 8px 10px 4px;
      display: flex; flex-wrap: nowrap; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(#a9abb2 0, #62646b 5%, #3b3c41 50%, #1d1d20 51%, #2b2c30 100%);
      border-top: 1px solid #d5d6db; box-shadow: 0 -2px 6px #0006;
    }
    body.layout-ios .nav-button {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; min-width: 62px; padding: 0 2px;
      color: #fff; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; transform: none; filter: none;
      font-size: 10px; font-weight: bold; line-height: 1.1; white-space: nowrap; transition: none;
    }
    body.layout-ios .nav-button::before {
      display: grid; place-items: center; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 28px;
      background: var(--ios-gloss), linear-gradient(var(--ic1), var(--ic2));
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #00000040, 0 2px 4px #000000a0;
    }
    body.layout-ios nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(1)::before { content: "🏠"; --ic1: #5aaaf5; --ic2: #1b62c8; }
    body.layout-ios nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(2)::before { content: "📢"; --ic1: #ff7a7a; --ic2: #c4161c; }
    body.layout-ios nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(3)::before { content: "🎮"; --ic1: #ffa857; --ic2: #d44a00; }
    body.layout-ios nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(4)::before { content: "💬"; --ic1: #6fdc5a; --ic2: #1f9a2a; }
    body.layout-ios nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(5)::before { content: "ℹ️"; --ic1: #d2d2d6; --ic2: #6e6e76; }
    body.layout-ios nav .nav-button:nth-of-type(6)::before { content: "💡"; --ic1: #ffe27a; --ic2: #e7a900; }
    body.layout-ios .nav-button:hover { background: none; transform: none; border: 0; color: #fff; }
    body.layout-ios .nav-button:hover::before { filter: brightness(1.12); }
    body.layout-ios .nav-button:active::before { filter: brightness(.8); }
    body.layout-ios .nav-button.active { color: #fff; background: none; border: 0; transform: none; }
    body.layout-ios .nav-button.active::before { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #00000040, 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 10px #ffffffaa; }

    /* ---- page area ---- */
    body.layout-ios main { max-width: 980px; padding: 90px 18px 110px; }
    body.layout-ios .footer { margin-bottom: 84px; color: #4c566c; border-top: 1px solid #aab1bc; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #ffffffcc; }
    body.layout-ios .section-title {
      margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 26px; font-weight: bold; color: #4c566c; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #ffffffd9;
    }
    body.layout-ios .section-description { color: #4c566c; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #ffffffcc; }
    body.layout-ios .announcement-date { color: #385487; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; }
    body.layout-ios label { color: #4c566c; font-weight: bold; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fffc; }
    body.layout-ios .gs-meta { color: #4c566c; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fffc; }
    body.layout-ios .gs-meta b { color: #222; }

    /* ---- buttons: glossy blue bar buttons ---- */
    body.layout-ios .button {
      color: #fff; border: 1px solid #2d4f8e; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 18px;
      font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; text-shadow: 0 -1px 0 #00000080;
      background: linear-gradient(#ffffff59 0, #ffffff1a 50%, #ffffff00 50%), linear-gradient(#7396d6, #3d63ac);
      box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff66, 0 1px 1px #ffffffb3; transform: none; filter: none; transition: none;
    }
    body.layout-ios .button:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: none; }
    body.layout-ios .button:active { filter: brightness(.82); }
    body.layout-ios .button.secondary {
      color: #333; border-color: #7b8189; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #ffffffcc;
      background: linear-gradient(#ffffff99 0, #ffffff33 50%, #ffffff00 50%), linear-gradient(#f4f5f7, #b7bcc5);
    }

    /* ---- grouped-table panels ---- */
    body.layout-ios .hero {
      padding: 44px 22px; background: linear-gradient(#fff, #f1f3f6); border: 1px solid #a8aeb8; border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #ffffffcc; }
    body.layout-ios .hero h1 { color: #222; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fff; }
    body.layout-ios .hero p { color: #555; }
    body.layout-ios .grid { gap: 18px; }
    body.layout-ios .card, body.layout-ios .suggestion-card, body.layout-ios .announcement {
      overflow: hidden; color: #222; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #a8aeb8; border-radius: 11px;
      box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #ffffffcc; animation: none; transition: none;
    }
    body.layout-ios .card:hover { transform: none; filter: brightness(.97); }
    body.layout-ios .card h3 { color: #222; font-size: 18px; font-weight: bold; }
    body.layout-ios .card p { color: #555; }
    body.layout-ios .gаmе-image { border-radius: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #c8ccd2; }

    /* ---- inputs: classic iOS search pill ---- */
    body.layout-ios .field, body.layout-ios input, body.layout-ios textarea, body.layout-ios select {
      color: #222; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #8e97a6; border-radius: 7px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px #0000004d;
    }
    body.layout-ios .field:focus, body.layout-ios .field.game-search:focus-within { border-color: #2f5bb0; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px #0000004d, 0 0 0 2px #2f5bb040; transform: none; }
    body.layout-ios .field.game-search { height: 42px; border-radius: 21px; }
    body.layout-ios .game-search input.gs-input { border: 0; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; }
    body.layout-ios .game-search .gs-icon { color: #8e97a6; }
    body.layout-ios .game-search .gs-kbd, body.layout-ios .game-search .gs-clear { color: #fff; background: #9aa1ad; border-color: #9aa1ad; }

    /* ---- settings: like the old Settings app ---- */
    body.layout-ios .settings-overlay { background: #000000a6; backdrop-filter: none; }
    body.layout-ios .settings-dialog {
      color: #222; background: var(--ios-pin); border: 1px solid #333; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 10px 40px #000000b3; }
    body.layout-ios .settings-heading h2 { color: #4c566c; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fff; }
    body.layout-ios .settings-intro, body.layout-ios .panic-note, body.layout-ios .panic-label { color: #4c566c; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #fffc; }
    body.layout-ios .settings-tabs { gap: 0; }
    body.layout-ios .settings-tab {
      color: #2f5bb0; font-weight: bold; border: 1px solid #2f5bb0; border-radius: 0; transform: none; box-shadow: none;
      background: linear-gradient(#ffffff, #dfe4ee);
    }
    body.layout-ios .settings-tab:first-child { border-radius: 7px 0 0 7px; }
    body.layout-ios .settings-tab:last-child { border-radius: 0 7px 7px 0; border-left: 0; }
    body.layout-ios .settings-tab:hover { transform: none; filter: brightness(.96); }
    body.layout-ios .settings-tab.active { color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 -1px 0 #0006; background: var(--ios-gloss), linear-gradient(#5f87cc, #2f5bb0); }
    body.layout-ios .layout-option { color: #222; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #a8aeb8; border-radius: 10px; transition: none; }
    body.layout-ios .layout-option:hover { transform: none; border-color: #2f5bb0; }
    body.layout-ios .layout-option strong { color: #222; }
    body.layout-ios .layout-option span { color: #666; }
    body.layout-ios .layout-option.selected { border: 1px solid #2d4f8e; background: var(--ios-gloss), linear-gradient(#6f93d2, #3d63ac); }
    body.layout-ios .layout-option.selected strong { color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 -1px 0 #0006; }
    body.layout-ios .layout-option.selected span { color: #e4ecff; }
    body.layout-ios .settings-close { color: #333; background: linear-gradient(#f4f5f7, #b7bcc5); border: 1px solid #7b8189; border-radius: 8px; }
    body.layout-ios .settings-launcher {
      bottom: 98px; width: 52px; height: 52px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; color: #222;
      background: var(--ios-gloss), linear-gradient(#d2d2d6, #6e6e76); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #00000040, 0 2px 6px #000000a0;
    }
    body.layout-ios .settings-launcher:hover { transform: none; filter: brightness(1.1); }
    body.layout-ios ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 7px; height: 7px; }
    body.layout-ios ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #00000080; border-radius: 4px; }
    @media (max-width: 560px) {
      body.layout-ios nav { gap: 2px; padding-left: 4px; padding-right: 4px; }
      body.layout-ios .nav-button { min-width: 52px; font-size: 9px; }
      body.layout-ios .nav-button::before { width: 44px; height: 44px; font-size: 24px; }
      body.layout-ios .brand { font-size: 17px; }
    }

    /* ---- theme search box inside the settings window (reuses the games search look) ---- */
    .theme-search-wrap { margin: 14px 0 2px; }
    /* The genie copy of the window has its ids stripped, so these also match it by data attribute
       (:is() keeps the same specificity as the id). Otherwise the copy is a different size and
       the content jumps when the real window takes over. */
    :is(#settingsPanelLayout, .genie-strip [data-settings-panel="layout"]) .theme-search-wrap .field.game-search { height: 46px; margin: 0; }
    :is(#settingsPanelLayout, .genie-strip [data-settings-panel="layout"]) .theme-meta { min-height: 20px; margin: 8px 4px 0; font-size: 13px; }
    :is(#settingsPanelLayout, .genie-strip [data-settings-panel="layout"]) .theme-empty { margin-top: 14px; padding: 26px 14px; }
  </style>
</head>

<body>
  <header class="topbar">
    <div class="brand"><span class="brand-emoji">🦃</span> <span>ULTRA</span> GАМЕ STASH</div>

    <nav>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button active" data-page="home" data-dock-label="Home" onclick="showPage("home")">Home</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="announcements" data-dock-label="Announcements" onclick="showPage("announcements")">Announcements</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="gаmеs" data-dock-label="Gаmеs" onclick="showPage("gаmеs")">Gаmеs</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="сhаt" data-dock-label="Сhаt" onclick="showPage("сhаt")">Сhаt</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="about" data-dock-label="About" onclick="showPage("about")">About</button>
      <button type="button" class="nav-button" data-page="suggestions" data-dock-label="Suggestions" onclick="showPage("suggestions")">Suggestions</button>
    </nav>

    <div class="sg-user" aria-hidden="true"><span class="sg-avatar"></span><span>User • <b>ONLINE</b></span></div>
  </header>

  <main>
    <section id="home" class="page active">
      <div class="hero">
        <h1>🦃 Ultra Gаmе Stash</h1>
        <p>
          Welcome to your cozy fall gаmіng hideout!
          Find gаmеs, check announcements, talk with other players,
          and suggest what should be added next.
        </p>

        <div class="button-row" style="justify-content:center">
          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('gаmеs')">🎮 Browse Gаmеs</button>
          <button class="button secondary" onclick="showPage('announcements')">
            📰 Announcements
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="grid">
        <div class="card">
          <h3>🎮 Gаmеs</h3>
          <p>Open your favorite gаmеs from the stash.</p>
          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('gаmеs')">View Gаmеs</button>
        </div>

        <div class="card">
          <h3>💬 Сhаt</h3>
          <p>Talk with other players in the external сhаt.</p>
          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('сhаt')">Enter Сhаt</button>
        </div>

        <div class="card">
          <h3>💡 Suggestions</h3>
          <p>Tell us which gаmеs or features you want added.</p>
          <button class="button" onclick="showPage('suggestions')">Suggest Something</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section id="announcements" class="page">

    /*
      ============================================================
      FETCH HTML AND WRITE IT INTO ABOUT:BLANK
      ============================================================

      This follows your example:
        1. Open about:blank immediately from the click.
        2. Fetch the configured URL.
        3. Read the response as text.
        4. Write the HTML into the blank tab.

      Relative asset URLs are given the original page's base URL.
    */

    function openInAboutBlank(url) {
      let parsedUrl;
      let newWindow;

      try {
        parsedUrl = new URL(url);
        if (parsedUrl.protocol !== "https:" || parsedUrl.hostname !== "cdn.jsdelivr.net") {
          throw new Error("Only HTTPS URLs hosted on cdn.jsdelivr.net are allowed.");
        }
      } catch (error) {
        alert("Invalid URL: " + error.message);
        return;
      }

      // Open the blank tab immediately during the click, before any async work.
      newWindow = window.open("about:blank", "_blank");

      if (!newWindow) {
        alert("Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.");
        return;
      }

      function showLoading() {
        try {
          newWindow.document.open();
          newWindow.document.write(
            "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><title>Loading...</title>" +
            "<style>body{background:#111;color:#ffad42;font-family:sans-serif;" +
            "display:grid;place-items:center;height:90vh}</style></head>" +
            "<body>Loading gаmе...</body></html>"
          );
          newWindow.document.close();
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Could not display loading page:", error);
        }
      }

      function showError(message) {
        if (!newWindow || newWindow.closed) return;
        const safeMessage = String(message || "Unknown error").replace(/[&<>"]/g, ch => ({
          "&": "&", "<": "<", ">": ">", '"': """
        }[ch]));

        try {
          newWindow.document.open();
          newWindow.document.write(
            "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset='UTF-8'><title>Unable to load</title>" +
            "<style>body{background:#111;color:#fff;font-family:sans-serif;padding:30px}" +
            "h2{color:#ffad42}</style></head><body><h2>Could not load this page</h2><p>" +
            safeMessage + "</p><p>The URL must be reachable and return HTML.</p></body></html>"
          );
          newWindow.document.close();
        } catch (error) {
          alert("Could not load page: " + message);
        }
      }

      function writeFetchedHtml(html) {
        if (!newWindow || newWindow.closed) return;

        const baseHref = new URL(".", parsedUrl.href).href;
        const baseTag = '<base href="' +
          baseHref.replace(/&/g, "&").replace(/"/g, """) + '">';

        html = String(html).replace(/<base\b[^>]*>/gi, "");

        if (/<head\b[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
          html = html.replace(/<head\b[^>]*>/i, match => match + baseTag);
        } else if (/<html\b[^>]*>/i.test(html)) {
          html = html.replace(/<html\b[^>]*>/i, match =>
            match + "<head>" + baseTag + "</head>"
          );
        } else {
          html = "<!DOCTYPE html><html><head>" + baseTag +
            "</head><body>" + html + "</body></html>";
        }

        newWindow.document.open();
        newWindow.document.write(html);
        newWindow.document.close();
      }

      showLoading();

      // Apps Script fetches the HTML server-side to avoid browser CORS failures.
      if (window.google && google.script && google.script.run) {
        google.script.run
          .withSuccessHandler(writeFetchedHtml)
          .withFailureHandler(error => showError(error && error.message ? error.message : error))
          .fetchRemoteHtml(parsedUrl.href);
      } else {
        // Fallback for copies opened outside Apps Script, if the host permits CORS.
        fetch(parsedUrl.href)
          .then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
            return response.text();
          })
          .then(writeFetchedHtml)
          .catch(error => showError(error.message || error));
      }
    }

    function openConfiguredСhаt() {

    }

    function makeCard(title, description, buttonText, url, extraText, imageUrl) {
      const card = document.createElement("article");
      card.className = "card";

      // Optional image. With no URL (or if it fails to load) the card looks exactly like before.
      if (imageUrl && String(imageUrl).trim()) {
        const image = document.createElement("img");
        image.className = "gаmе-image";
        image.alt = title;
        image.addEventListener("load", () => image.classList.add("is-loaded"));
        image.loading = "lazy";
        image.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
        image.addEventListener("error", () => image.remove());
        image.src = String(imageUrl).trim();
        card.appendChild(image);
      }

      const heading = document.createElement("h3");
      heading.textContent = title;
      card.appendChild(heading);

      if (extraText) {
        const extra = document.createElement("div");
        extra.className = "announcement-date";
        extra.textContent = extraText;
        card.appendChild(extra);
      }

      const paragraph = document.createElement("p");
      paragraph.textContent = description;
      card.appendChild(paragraph);

      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.className = "button";
      button.textContent = buttonText;

      // Both gаmе and announcement buttons use the fetch-to-about:blank method.
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        recordCompleted(/^Play/i.test(buttonText) ? "Played " + title + "!" : "Checked announcements!");
        openInAboutBlank(url);
      });

      card.appendChild(button);
      return card;
    }

    function renderGаmеs() {
      const grid = document.getElementById("gаmеsGrid");
      grid.replaceChildren();

      gаmеs.forEach(gаmе => {
        grid.appendChild(
          makeCard(gаmе.title, gаmе.description, "Play Gаmе →", gаmе.url, "", gаmе.image)
        );
      });
    }

    function renderAnnouncements() {
      const grid = document.getElementById("announcementsGrid");
      grid.replaceChildren();

      announcements.forEach(announcement => {
        grid.appendChild(
          makeCard(
            announcement.title,
            announcement.description,
            "Open Announcement →",
            announcement.url,
            announcement.date || ""
          )
        );
      });
    }

    let pageSwitchTimer = 0;
    function showPage(pageId) {
      document.querySelectorAll(".nav-button").forEach(button => {
        button.classList.toggle("active", button.dataset.page === pageId);
      });

      const next = document.getElementById(pageId);
      if (!next) return;

      const reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
      const pages = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(".page"));
      const current = pages.find(p => p.classList.contains("active") && !p.classList.contains("leaving"));

      clearTimeout(pageSwitchTimer);
      // Finish off any page that was still fading out from an earlier click.
      pages.forEach(p => { if (p !== next && p !== current) p.classList.remove("active", "leaving"); });
      next.classList.remove("leaving");
      if (current === next) return;

      const reveal = () => {
        if (current) current.classList.remove("active", "leaving");
        next.classList.add("active");
        if (window.scrollY > 0) window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: reduce ? "auto" : "smooth" });
      };

      if (!current || reduce) { reveal(); return; }
      current.classList.add("leaving");
      pageSwitchTimer = setTimeout(reveal, 170);
    }

      h = h % 12 || 12;
      document.body.style.setProperty("--ios-time", '"' + h + ":" + m + " " + ap + '"');

    const PAL_FLAG_TEXT = {
      float: "a rounded hanging header", tabs: "folder-style page tabs", navpill: "a pill-shaped page bar",
      column: "a single narrow column of cards", masonry: "staggered masonry columns",
      list: "games shown as wide list rows", frame: "a thin frame around the screen"
    };
    const PAL_FLAG_WORDS = {
      float: "floating hanging header card", tabs: "tabs folder", navpill: "pill capsule bar", column: "narrow single feed",
      masonry: "staggered pinterest", list: "rows wide", frame: "border frame outline", slim: "narrow sidebar",
      sidedock: "vertical dock side"
    };
    const PAL_BY_ID = {};
    (function buildPaletteThemes() {
      const panel = document.getElementById("settingsPanelLayout");
      const keywords = {};
      let number = availableLayouts.length + 1;
      PALETTES.forEach(row => {
        const flags = row[5].split(" ").filter(Boolean);
        const id = "p-" + row[0];
        const base = row[4];
        const pal = {
          id, emoji: row[1], name: row[2], tagline: row[3], base,
          flags, leaves: row[7], brand: row[8], colors: row[9]
        };
        PAL_BY_ID[id] = pal;
        availableLayouts.push(id);
        keywords[id] = row[6] + " " + flags.join(" ") + " color theme palette";
        if (!panel) return;
        const side = flags.includes("right") ? "right" : "left";
        let layoutName = PAL_BASE_TEXT[base];
        if (base === "sidebar") layoutName = (flags.includes("slim") ? "slim" : "tall") + " menu down the " + side + " side";
        if (base === "bottom" && flags.includes("sidedock")) layoutName = "vertical page dock on the " + side + " edge";
        const extras = flags.map(f => PAL_FLAG_TEXT[f]).filter(Boolean);
        const button = document.createElement("button");
        button.type = "button";
        button.className = "layout-option";
        button.setAttribute("data-layout-choice", id);
        button.setAttribute("onclick", "setLayout('" + id + "')");
        const strong = document.createElement("strong");
        strong.textContent = row[1] + " " + (number++) + ". " + row[2];
        const span = document.createElement("span");
        span.textContent = row[3] + ". Uses the " + layoutName + (extras.length ? ", with " + extras.join(" and ") : "") + ".";
        keywords[id] += " " + flags.map(f => PAL_FLAG_WORDS[f] || "").join(" ");
        button.appendChild(strong);
        button.appendChild(span);
        panel.appendChild(button);
      });
      window.UGS_PAL_KEYWORDS = keywords;
    })();
    const PAL_PROPS = ["bg", "panel", "panel2", "border", "a", "b", "c", "t", "mt", "ink"];
    const PAL_BODY_CLASSES = ["pal-on", "pal-sharp", "pal-pill", "pal-dense", "pal-big", "pal-right", "pal-rise", "pal-font", "pal-head", "pal-float", "pal-slim", "pal-tabs", "pal-navpill", "pal-column", "pal-masonry", "pal-list", "pal-frame", "pal-sidedock"];
    function applyPalette(pal) {
      const body = document.body;
      PAL_BODY_CLASSES.forEach(c => body.classList.remove(c));
      PAL_PROPS.forEach(p => body.style.removeProperty("--p-" + p));
      ["--p-font", "--p-head", "--p-brand"].forEach(p => body.style.removeProperty(p));
      if (!pal) { setLeafIcons(DEFAULT_LEAVES); return; }
      body.classList.add("pal-on");
      PAL_PROPS.forEach((p, i) => body.style.setProperty("--p-" + p, pal.colors[i]));
      ["sharp", "pill", "dense", "big", "right", "rise", "float", "slim", "tabs", "navpill", "column", "masonry", "list", "frame", "sidedock"].forEach(f => { if (pal.flags.includes(f)) body.classList.add("pal-" + f); });
      const fontKey = ["serif", "mono", "round"].find(f => pal.flags.includes(f));
      if (fontKey) { body.classList.add("pal-font"); body.style.setProperty("--p-font", PAL_FONTS[fontKey]); }
      if (pal.flags.includes("chunk")) { body.classList.add("pal-head"); body.style.setProperty("--p-head", PAL_HEAD_CHUNK); }
      body.style.setProperty("--p-brand", JSON.stringify(pal.brand || ""));
      setLeafIcons(pal.leaves);
    }
    const mainNavigation = document.querySelector(".topbar > nav");
    const originalNavigationParent = mainNavigation ? mainNavigation.parentElement : null;

    // ============================================================
    // LIQUID GLASS DOCK ENGINE
    // A single glass lens lives inside the dock, behind the icons. It is described by four
    // spring-driven edges (left/right/top/bottom) so it can MOLD: when the pointer is near the
    // dock's outline the lens is a half-circle arch that is pulled out of that rim (its flat base
    // stays welded to the outline and its dome follows the pointer); as the pointer moves inward
    // the arch swells and rounds off into the full rounded square that cradles the icon. Leaving
    // does the reverse, sinking back into the rim. The lens never leaves the dock's bounds.
    // Everything is transform/opacity in one requestAnimationFrame loop that sleeps at rest.
    // ============================================================
    let liquidDockLens = null;
    let liquidDockReset = () => {};
    function setupLiquidDockLens() {
      if (!mainNavigation || liquidDockLens) return;
      const nav = mainNavigation;
      const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)") : { matches: false };

      liquidDockLens = document.createElement("span");
      liquidDockLens.className = "liquid-dock-lens";
      liquidDockLens.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      nav.insertBefore(liquidDockLens, nav.firstChild);
      const lens = liquidDockLens;

      // ---- tiny spring toolkit ----
      const mk = (value, k, c, eps = .02) => ({ x: value, v: 0, t: value, k, c, eps });
      const snap = (s, v) => { s.x = s.t = v; s.v = 0; };
      const atRest = s => Math.abs(s.x - s.t) < s.eps && Math.abs(s.v) < s.eps * 5;
      const clamp = (v, lo, hi) => Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v));
      const smooth = t => { t = clamp(t, 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); };
      function step(s, dt, K, C) {
        const a = -s.k * K * (s.x - s.t) - s.c * C * s.v;
        s.v += a * dt;
        s.x += s.v * dt;
      }

      const L = {
        l: mk(0, 150, 23), r: mk(0, 150, 23),
        t: mk(0, 130, 21), b: mk(0, 130, 21),
        att: mk(1, 120, 20, .002),      // 1 = welded to the rim (arch), 0 = free rounded square
        pres: mk(0, 110, 19, .002),     // opacity
        press: mk(0, 400, 28, .002)     // mouse/finger-down squish
      };
      const MAG = .16, LIFT = 3, SIGMA = 64, PAD = 10, EDGE_PAD = 3;

      let btns = [];
      function measure() {
        btns = Array.from(nav.querySelectorAll(":scope > .nav-button")).map((el, i) => {
          const prev = btns[i];
          return {
            el, cx: el.offsetLeft + el.offsetWidth / 2, top: el.offsetTop, w: el.offsetWidth, h: el.offsetHeight,
            s: prev ? prev.s : mk(1, 430, 27, .0008),
            lift: prev ? prev.lift : mk(0, 430, 27, .02),
            press: prev ? prev.press : mk(0, 560, 30, .002),
            infl: 0
          };
        });
      }
      const halfPitch = i => {
        const d = [80];
        if (btns[i - 1]) d.push(btns[i].cx - btns[i - 1].cx);
        if (btns[i + 1]) d.push(btns[i + 1].cx - btns[i].cx);
        return Math.min(...d) / 2;
      };

      const ptr = { inside: false, x: 0, y: 0, down: -1, edge: "bottom" };
      const isLiquid = () => document.body.classList.contains("layout-liquid");
      function localPoint(e) {
        const r = nav.getBoundingClientRect();
        ptr.x = e.clientX - r.left - nav.clientLeft;
        ptr.y = e.clientY - r.top - nav.clientTop;
      }
      // Nearest outline edge, with a little hysteresis so the arch never flickers between edges.
      function pickEdge(navW, navH) {
        const d = { left: ptr.x, right: navW - ptr.x, top: ptr.y, bottom: navH - ptr.y };
        const m = Math.min(d.left, d.right, d.top, d.bottom);
        if (d[ptr.edge] > m + 6) ptr.edge = Object.keys(d).find(k => d[k] === m);
        return d[ptr.edge];
      }
      // The arch: a half circle whose flat base is welded to the rim at the pointer, tip reaching toward the pointer.
      function archRect(edge, depth, navW, navH) {
        const tip = Math.max(6, depth + 8);
        const half = tip;                                  // half-width == height, so it's a true half circle
        const M = 24;                                      // keep clear of the dock's rounded corners
        const px = clamp(ptr.x, half + M, navW - half - M);
        const py = clamp(ptr.y, half + M, navH - half - M);
        if (edge === "bottom") return { l: px - half, r: px + half, t: navH - 1 - tip, b: navH - 1 };
        if (edge === "top")    return { l: px - half, r: px + half, t: 1, b: 1 + tip };
        if (edge === "left")   return { l: 1, r: 1 + tip, t: py - half, b: py + half };
        return { l: navW - 1 - tip, r: navW - 1, t: py - half, b: py + half };
      }

      function retarget() {
        const motion = reduceMotion.matches ? 0 : 1;
        const navW = nav.clientWidth, navH = nav.clientHeight;
        let near = -1, best = Infinity;
        if (ptr.inside) btns.forEach((b, i) => { const d = Math.abs(ptr.x - b.cx); if (d < best) { best = d; near = i; } });

        btns.forEach((b, i) => {
          const d = ptr.x - b.cx;
          b.infl = ptr.inside ? Math.exp(-(d * d) / (2 * SIGMA * SIGMA)) : 0;
          b.s.t = 1 + MAG * motion * b.infl;
          b.lift.t = LIFT * motion * b.infl;
          b.press.t = ptr.down === i ? 1 : 0;
        });

        let T;
        if (ptr.inside && near >= 0) {
          const depth = Math.max(0, pickEdge(navW, navH));
          const depthT = smooth(depth / Math.max(20, Math.min(40, navH * .36)));
          const A = archRect(ptr.edge, depth, navW, navH);

          // Full rounded square around the icon under the pointer, clamped to stay inside the dock.
          const b = btns[near];
          const d = ptr.x - b.cx;
          const s = b.s.x;
          const between = smooth(Math.abs(d) / halfPitch(near));
          const fw = Math.min((b.w * s + PAD + 6) * (1 - .2 * between), navW - 2 * EDGE_PAD);
          const fh = Math.min(b.h * s + PAD, navH - 2 * EDGE_PAD);
          const visCy = (b.top + b.h) - b.lift.x - (b.h * s) / 2;
          const fx = clamp(ptr.x + (b.cx - ptr.x) * .4 * (1 - between), fw / 2 + EDGE_PAD, navW - fw / 2 - EDGE_PAD);
          const fy = clamp(visCy, fh / 2 + EDGE_PAD, navH - fh / 2 - EDGE_PAD);
          const F = { l: fx - fw / 2, r: fx + fw / 2, t: fy - fh / 2, b: fy + fh / 2 };

          T = {};
          for (const k of ["l", "r", "t", "b"]) T[k] = A[k] + (F[k] - A[k]) * depthT;
          L.att.t = 1 - depthT;
          L.pres.t = 1;
        } else {
          // Leaving: the lens sinks back into the rim the pointer left through.
          pickEdge(navW, navH);
          T = archRect(ptr.edge, 0, navW, navH);
          const cx = (T.l + T.r) / 2, cy = (T.t + T.b) / 2;
          const rimX = ptr.edge === "left" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "right" ? navW - 1 : cx;
          const rimY = ptr.edge === "top" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "bottom" ? navH - 1 : cy;
          T = { l: Math.min(cx, rimX) - (ptr.edge === "left" || ptr.edge === "right" ? 0 : 7), r: Math.max(cx, rimX) + (ptr.edge === "left" || ptr.edge === "right" ? 0 : 7),
                t: Math.min(cy, rimY) - (ptr.edge === "top" || ptr.edge === "bottom" ? 0 : 7), b: Math.max(cy, rimY) + (ptr.edge === "top" || ptr.edge === "bottom" ? 0 : 7) };
          L.att.t = 1;
          L.pres.t = 0;
        }
        L.l.t = T.l; L.r.t = T.r; L.t.t = T.t; L.b.t = T.b;
        L.press.t = ptr.inside && ptr.down >= 0 ? 1 : 0;
      }

      function render() {
        btns.forEach(b => {
          const g = clamp((b.s.x - 1) / MAG, 0, 1);
          const sc = b.s.x * (1 - .07 * b.press.x);
          b.el.style.transform = `translate3d(0, ${(-b.lift.x).toFixed(2)}px, 0) scale(${sc.toFixed(4)})`;
          b.el.style.setProperty("--i", g.toFixed(3));
          b.el.style.zIndex = String(2 + Math.round(g * 2));
        });

        const navW = nav.clientWidth, navH = nav.clientHeight;
        const squish = 1 - .06 * L.press.x;
        const vx = reduceMotion.matches ? 0 : (L.l.v + L.r.v) / 2;
        const st = clamp(Math.abs(vx) / 1700, 0, .2);            // horizontal liquid stretch while moving
        let w = Math.max(1, (L.r.x - L.l.x) * squish * (1 + st));
        let h = Math.max(1, (L.b.x - L.t.x) * squish);
        let cx = (L.l.x + L.r.x) / 2, cy = (L.t.x + L.b.x) / 2;
        // Hard guarantee: the lens never pokes outside the dock.
        cx = clamp(cx, Math.min(w / 2, navW / 2), Math.max(navW - w / 2, navW / 2));
        cy = clamp(cy, Math.min(h / 2, navH / 2), Math.max(navH - h / 2, navH / 2));
        const sx = w / 100, sy = h / 100;

        // Corner radii (separate horizontal/vertical): while attached, the two tip corners are elliptical
        // quarter-arcs that join into a half circle; base corners (on the rim side) stay tight.
        // As att -> 0 everything blends back to the normal uniform rounded-square radius R.
        const R = Math.min(26, Math.min(w, h) / 2);
        const att = clamp(L.att.x, 0, 1);
        const rb = R - (R - 3) * att;
        const mix = target => R + (target - R) * att;
        const sideEdge = ptr.edge === "left" || ptr.edge === "right";
        const tipX = Math.max(.5, mix(sideEdge ? w - rb : w / 2));
        const tipY = Math.max(.5, mix(sideEdge ? h / 2 : h - rb));
        let tl = [tipX, tipY], tr = [tipX, tipY], br = [tipX, tipY], bl = [tipX, tipY];
        const base = [rb, rb];
        if (ptr.edge === "bottom") { br = base; bl = base; }
        else if (ptr.edge === "top") { tl = base; tr = base; }
        else if (ptr.edge === "left") { tl = base; bl = base; }
        else { tr = base; br = base; }
        const fx = a => (a / sx).toFixed(2) + "px";
        const fy = a => (a / sy).toFixed(2) + "px";
        lens.style.transform = `translate3d(${(cx - 50).toFixed(2)}px, ${(cy - 50).toFixed(2)}px, 0) scale(${sx.toFixed(4)}, ${sy.toFixed(4)})`;
        lens.style.borderRadius =
          `${fx(tl[0])} ${fx(tr[0])} ${fx(br[0])} ${fx(bl[0])} / ${fy(tl[1])} ${fy(tr[1])} ${fy(br[1])} ${fy(bl[1])}`;
        lens.style.opacity = clamp(L.pres.x * 1.8, 0, 1).toFixed(3);
      }

      function allRest() {
        return Object.values(L).every(atRest) && btns.every(b => atRest(b.s) && atRest(b.lift) && atRest(b.press));
      }
      function cleanup() {
        lens.style.opacity = "0";
        lens.style.transform = "translate3d(0,0,0) scale(.01)";
        btns.forEach(b => {
          b.el.style.transform = ""; b.el.style.zIndex = "";
          b.el.style.removeProperty("--i");
          snap(b.s, 1); snap(b.lift, 0); snap(b.press, 0);
        });
      }

      let raf = 0, last = 0;
      function frame(now) {
        raf = 0;
        if (!isLiquid()) { cleanup(); return; }
        let dt = (now - last) / 1000; last = now;
        if (!(dt > 0)) dt = 1 / 60;
        dt = Math.min(dt, 1 / 30);
        const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(dt * 240)), h = dt / n;
        const K = reduceMotion.matches ? 4 : 1, C = reduceMotion.matches ? 2 : 1;
        retarget();
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          for (const k in L) step(L[k], h, K, C);
          for (const b of btns) { step(b.s, h, K, C); step(b.lift, h, K, C); step(b.press, h, K, C); }
        }
        render();
        if (!allRest()) raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        else if (!ptr.inside) cleanup();
      }
      function start() {
        if (raf) return;
        last = performance.now();
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }

      function enter(e) {
        if (!isLiquid()) return;
        const wasInside = ptr.inside;
        measure();
        localPoint(e);
        ptr.inside = true;
        // A fresh entrance starts as a zero-size bead sitting exactly where the pointer crossed
        // the outline; re-entering mid-exit simply reverses from wherever the lens currently is.
        if (!wasInside && L.pres.x < .04) {
          const navW = nav.clientWidth, navH = nav.clientHeight;
          ptr.edge = "bottom"; pickEdge(navW, navH);
          const x = clamp(ptr.x, 0, navW), y = clamp(ptr.y, 0, navH);
          const rimX = ptr.edge === "left" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "right" ? navW - 1 : x;
          const rimY = ptr.edge === "top" ? 1 : ptr.edge === "bottom" ? navH - 1 : y;
          snap(L.l, rimX); snap(L.r, rimX); snap(L.t, rimY); snap(L.b, rimY);
          snap(L.att, 1); snap(L.pres, 0);
        }
