      }
      nav.addEventListener("pointerenter", enter);
      nav.addEventListener("pointermove", e => {
        if (!isLiquid()) return;
        if (!ptr.inside) { enter(e); return; }
        localPoint(e);
        start();
      });
      nav.addEventListener("pointerleave", e => {
        if (!isLiquid() || !ptr.inside) return;
        localPoint(e);
        ptr.inside = false; ptr.down = -1;
        start();
      });
      nav.addEventListener("pointerdown", e => {
        if (!isLiquid()) return;
        if (!ptr.inside) enter(e); else localPoint(e);
        const btn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest(".nav-button");
        ptr.down = btn ? btns.findIndex(b => b.el === btn) : -1;
        start();
      });
      const release = () => { if (ptr.down !== -1) { ptr.down = -1; start(); } };
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", release);
      window.addEventListener("pointercancel", release);
      window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (isLiquid()) { measure(); start(); } });

      liquidDockReset = () => {
        if (raf) { cancelAnimationFrame(raf); raf = 0; }
        ptr.inside = false; ptr.down = -1;
        Object.values(L).forEach(s => snap(s, 0));
        snap(L.att, 1);
        cleanup();
      };
    }
    setupLiquidDockLens();
    const originalNavigationNextSibling = mainNavigation ? mainNavigation.nextSibling : null;

    const fmMainElement = document.querySelector("main");
    const fmWindowElement = document.getElementById("fmWindow");

    function placeNavigationForLayout(layout) {
      if (!mainNavigation || !originalNavigationParent) return;
      const fmSidebar = document.getElementById("fmSidebar");
      const fmContent = document.getElementById("fmContent");

      if (layout === "finder" && fmSidebar && fmContent && fmMainElement) {
        // File Manager: pages go in the sidebar, page contents go in the file area.
        fmSidebar.appendChild(mainNavigation);
        fmContent.appendChild(fmMainElement);
        return;
      }
      // Any other theme: put the page contents back where they normally live.
      if (fmMainElement && fmWindowElement && fmMainElement.parentElement !== document.body) {
        document.body.insertBefore(fmMainElement, fmWindowElement);
      }

      if (layout === "imac" || layout === "liquid") {
        // Make the dock a direct child of <body>, so fixed bottom positioning is viewport-based.
        if (mainNavigation.parentElement !== document.body) document.body.appendChild(mainNavigation);
      } else if (mainNavigation.parentElement !== originalNavigationParent) {
        if (originalNavigationNextSibling && originalNavigationNextSibling.parentElement === originalNavigationParent) {
          originalNavigationParent.insertBefore(mainNavigation, originalNavigationNextSibling);
        } else {
          originalNavigationParent.appendChild(mainNavigation);
        }
      }
    }

    function applyLayout(layout, saveChoice = true) {
      const safeLayout = availableLayouts.includes(layout) ? layout : "classic";
      const palette = PAL_BY_ID[safeLayout] || null;
      const structure = palette ? palette.base : safeLayout;   // color themes borrow one of the page layouts
      placeNavigationForLayout(structure);
      document.body.classList.remove("layout-sidebar", "layout-space", "layout-moonlight", "layout-arcade", "layout-pumpkin", "layout-bottom", "layout-topbar", "layout-schoology", "layout-imac", "layout-liquid", "layout-finder", "layout-minecraft", "layout-zelda", "layout-roblox", "layout-fortnite", "layout-ios");
      if (structure === "sidebar") document.body.classList.add("layout-sidebar");
      if (structure === "moonlight") document.body.classList.add("layout-moonlight");
      if (structure === "bottom") document.body.classList.add("layout-bottom");
      if (structure === "topbar") document.body.classList.add("layout-topbar");
      if (structure === "space") document.body.classList.add("layout-space");
      if (structure === "schoology") document.body.classList.add("layout-schoology");
      if (structure === "imac") document.body.classList.add("layout-imac");
      if (structure === "liquid") document.body.classList.add("layout-liquid");
      if (structure === "finder") document.body.classList.add("layout-finder");
      if (structure === "minecraft") document.body.classList.add("layout-minecraft");
      if (structure === "zelda") document.body.classList.add("layout-zelda");
      if (structure === "roblox") document.body.classList.add("layout-roblox");
      if (structure === "fortnite") document.body.classList.add("layout-fortnite");
      if (structure === "ios") document.body.classList.add("layout-ios");

      applyPalette(palette);

      // Stop the Liquid Glass spring engine and clear its inline styles when leaving the theme.
      if (safeLayout !== "liquid") liquidDockReset();

      document.querySelectorAll("[data-layout-choice]").forEach(option => {
        const selected = option.dataset.layoutChoice === safeLayout;
        option.classList.toggle("selected", selected);
        option.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(selected));
      });

      if (saveChoice) {
        try { localStorage.setItem("ugsWebsiteLayout", safeLayout); }
        catch (error) { /* Settings still work for this page view if storage is blocked. */ }
      }
    }

    function setLayout(layout) {
      const reduce = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
      // Fade smoothly from one layout to the next where the browser supports it.
      if (document.startViewTransition && !reduce) {
        try { document.startViewTransition(() => applyLayout(layout)); return; }
        catch (error) { /* fall through to the instant switch */ }
      }
      applyLayout(layout);
    }

    /*
      Settings window "genie" (like a Mac window minimizing into the dock).
      The window is copied into thin horizontal strips. Every frame each strip
      gets its own width, sideways position and height, so the window funnels
      into the gear button: the bottom pinches in first, the top follows, and
      the sides sweep along a smooth S-curve. Opening is the same thing played
      backwards, and you can interrupt it any time (click again mid-animation).
    */
    const GENIE_STRIPS = 16;      // the shear makes 16 strips look as smooth as 40 plain ones
    const GENIE_KEYS = 36;        // animation keyframes (the browser blends between them)
    const GENIE_OPEN_MS = 760;
    const GENIE_CLOSE_MS = 600;
    const GENIE_STAGGER = 0.42;   // how far the top lags behind the bottom

    const genie = { active: false, layer: null, anims: [], g: null };

    function genieReduced() {
      return !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches);
    }
    function gClamp(x) { return x < 0 ? 0 : x > 1 ? 1 : x; }
    function gSmooth(x) { x = gClamp(x); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x); }
    function gSmoother(x) { x = gClamp(x); return x * x * x * (x * (x * 6 - 15) + 10); }
    function gEase(r) { r = gClamp(r); return r < .5 ? 4 * r * r * r : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * r + 2, 3) / 2; }
    function gLerp(a, b, t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }

    function genieBuild(overlay) {
      const dialog = overlay.querySelector(".settings-dialog");
      const launcher = document.getElementById("settingsLauncher");
      if (!dialog || !launcher) return false;

      overlay.classList.add("genie-playing");          // real window: hidden, resting pose
      const D = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
      const B = launcher.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (D.width < 10 || D.height < 10) { overlay.classList.remove("genie-playing"); return false; }

      const n = GENIE_STRIPS;
      const h = D.height / n;

      // A clean copy of the window to slice up.
      const tpl = dialog.cloneNode(true);
      tpl.removeAttribute("id");
      tpl.querySelectorAll("[id]").forEach(el => el.removeAttribute("id"));
      tpl.querySelectorAll("[onclick]").forEach(el => el.removeAttribute("onclick"));
      tpl.querySelectorAll("button, input, a, [tabindex]").forEach(el => el.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1"));
      const srcInputs = dialog.querySelectorAll("input, textarea");
      tpl.querySelectorAll("input, textarea").forEach((el, i) => { if (srcInputs[i]) el.value = srcInputs[i].value; });
      tpl.style.setProperty("width", D.width + "px", "important");
      tpl.style.setProperty("height", D.height + "px", "important");
      const scrolls = dialog.scrollHeight > dialog.clientHeight + 1;
      tpl.style.setProperty("overflow-x", "hidden", "important");
      tpl.style.setProperty("overflow-y", scrolls ? "scroll" : "hidden", "important");

      const layer = document.createElement("div");
      layer.className = "genie-layer";
      layer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      try { layer.inert = true; } catch (e) { /* older browsers */ }

      const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
      const strips = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const strip = document.createElement("div");
        strip.className = "genie-strip";
        strip.style.width = D.width + "px";
        strip.style.height = (h + 1.2) + "px";
        const copy = tpl.cloneNode(true);
        copy.style.top = (-i * h) + "px";
        strip.appendChild(copy);
        frag.appendChild(strip);
        strips.push({ el: strip, copy: copy });
      }
      layer.appendChild(frag);
      document.body.appendChild(layer);
      if (scrolls) strips.forEach(s => { s.copy.scrollTop = dialog.scrollTop; });
      document.body.classList.add("genie-busy");

      genie.layer = layer;
      genie.strips = strips;
      genie.g = {
        n: n, h: h, W: D.width,
        dcx: D.left + D.width / 2,
        dBottom: D.bottom,
        bx: B.width ? B.left + B.width / 2 : window.innerWidth - 45,
        by: B.height ? B.top + B.height / 2 : window.innerHeight - 45,
        minW: Math.max(.05, Math.min(.22, (B.width || 54) * .8 / D.width))
      };
      return true;
    }

    // Where every strip should be at animation progress p (0 = tucked into the gear, 1 = fully open).
    function genieShape(g, p) {
      const n = g.n;
      const span = 1 - GENIE_STAGGER;

      const wf = new Array(n + 1), cx = new Array(n + 1);
      for (let b = 0; b <= n; b++) {
        const lp = gClamp((p - (b / n) * GENIE_STAGGER) / span);   // 0 = top seam ... 1 = bottom seam
        wf[b] = gLerp(g.minW, 1, gSmoother(lp));     // pinch narrow near the gear
        cx[b] = gLerp(g.bx, g.dcx, gSmooth(lp));     // sweep sideways toward it
      }

      const yb = new Array(n + 1);
      yb[n] = gLerp(g.by, g.dBottom, gSmoother(gClamp((p - GENIE_STAGGER) / span)));
      for (let i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const lpMid = gClamp((p - ((i + .5) / n) * GENIE_STAGGER) / span);
        yb[i] = yb[i + 1] - g.h * Math.max(gSmooth(lpMid), .0004);
      }

      const out = new Array(n);
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const sx = (wf[i] + wf[i + 1]) / 2;
        const sy = (yb[i + 1] - yb[i]) / g.h;
        const k = (cx[i + 1] - cx[i]) / g.h;
        const e = cx[i] - sx * g.W / 2;
        out[i] = "matrix(" + sx.toFixed(5) + ",0," + k.toFixed(5) + "," + sy.toFixed(5) + "," + e.toFixed(2) + "," + yb[i].toFixed(2) + ")";
      }
      return { m: out, o: gClamp(p * 9) };
    }

    function genieFinish() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById("settingsOverlay");
      genie.anims.forEach(a => { a.onfinish = null; try { a.cancel(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } });
      genie.anims = [];
      if (genie.layer && genie.layer.parentNode) genie.layer.parentNode.removeChild(genie.layer);
      genie.layer = null; genie.strips = []; genie.g = null;
      genie.active = false;
      document.body.classList.remove("genie-busy");
      if (overlay) overlay.classList.remove("genie-playing");
      if (overlay && overlay.classList.contains("open")) {
        const closeButton = overlay.querySelector(".settings-close");
        if (closeButton) closeButton.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      }
    }

    function genieGo(dir) {
      const overlay = document.getElementById("settingsOverlay");
      if (!genie.active) {
        if (!genieBuild(overlay)) return false;
        genie.active = true;

        // Pre-compute every pose once. After this the browser animates on its own graphics
        // thread, so a busy page can't make the movement stutter.
        const frames = genie.strips.map(() => []);
        for (let k = 0; k <= GENIE_KEYS; k++) {
          const shape = genieShape(genie.g, gEase(k / GENIE_KEYS));
          for (let i = 0; i < genie.g.n; i++) frames[i].push({ transform: shape.m[i], opacity: shape.o });
        }
        genie.anims = genie.strips.map((s, i) => {
          const a = s.el.animate(frames[i], { duration: GENIE_OPEN_MS, easing: "linear", fill: "both" });
          a.pause();
          a.currentTime = dir > 0 ? 0 : GENIE_OPEN_MS;
          return a;
        });
        genie.anims[0].onfinish = genieFinish;
      }
      const rate = dir > 0 ? 1 : -(GENIE_OPEN_MS / GENIE_CLOSE_MS);
      genie.anims.forEach(a => {
        if (a.updatePlaybackRate) a.updatePlaybackRate(rate); else a.playbackRate = rate;
        a.play();
      });
      return true;
    }

    function openSettings() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById("settingsOverlay");
      const launcher = document.getElementById("settingsLauncher");
      if (overlay.classList.contains("open")) return;

      if (genieReduced()) {
        overlay.classList.add("open");
        launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
        return;
      }
      const ok = genieGo(1);                 // builds the strips first (or reverses a close in progress)
      overlay.classList.add("open");
      launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      if (!ok) overlay.classList.remove("genie-playing");   // couldn't build: plain fade, still works
    }

    function closeSettings() {
      const overlay = document.getElementById("settingsOverlay");
      const launcher = document.getElementById("settingsLauncher");
      if (!overlay.classList.contains("open")) return;

      stopPanicCapture();
      if (!genieReduced()) genieGo(-1);      // copy the open window BEFORE the open class goes away
      overlay.classList.remove("open");
      launcher.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      try { launcher.focus({ preventScroll: true }); } catch (error) { /* ignore */ }
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
      // Resizing mid-animation would leave the strips misplaced, so just finish.
      if (genie.active) genieFinish();
    });

    function closeSettingsFromBackdrop(event) {
      if (event.target === document.getElementById("settingsOverlay")) closeSettings();
    }

    document.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.key === "Escape") closeSettings();
    });

    /*
      ============================================================
      SETTINGS TABS + PANIC KEY
      Defaults: key = the tilde / backtick key, link = d303.schoology.com
      ============================================================
    */
    const PANIC_DEFAULT_URL = "https://d303.schoology.com";
    const PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY = { key: "`", code: "Backquote" };
    const PANIC_STORAGE = "ugsPanicSettings";

    let panicSettings = {
      enabled: true,
      key: PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY.key,
      code: PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY.code,
      url: PANIC_DEFAULT_URL
    };
    let panicCapturing = false;
    let panicStatusTimer = 0;

    function showSettingsTab(name) {
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-settings-tab]").forEach(tab => {
        const on = tab.dataset.settingsTab === name;
        tab.classList.toggle("active", on);
        tab.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(on));
      });
      document.querySelectorAll("[data-settings-panel]").forEach(panel => {
        panel.classList.toggle("active", panel.dataset.settingsPanel === name);
      });
      if (name !== "panic") stopPanicCapture();
    }

    function normalizePanicUrl(raw) {
      raw = String(raw || "").trim();
      if (!raw) return PANIC_DEFAULT_URL;
      if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:\/\//i.test(raw)) raw = "https://" + raw;
      try {
        const u = new URL(raw);
        if (u.protocol !== "https:" && u.protocol !== "http:") return null;
        return u.href;
      } catch (error) {
        return null;
      }
    }

    function panicKeyName(key, code) {
      if (code === "Backquote" || key === "`" || key === "~") return "` (Tilde key)";
      if (key === " ") return "Space";
      if (key && key.length === 1) return key.toUpperCase();
      return key || "Not set";
    }

    function savePanicToStorage() {
      try { localStorage.setItem(PANIC_STORAGE, JSON.stringify(panicSettings)); }
      catch (error) { /* Still works for this page view if storage is blocked. */ }
    }

    function showPanicStatus(message) {
      const box = document.getElementById("panicStatus");
      if (!box) return;
      box.textContent = message;
      clearTimeout(panicStatusTimer);
      if (message) panicStatusTimer = setTimeout(() => { box.textContent = ""; }, 3500);
    }

    function renderPanicSettings() {
      const label = document.getElementById("panicKeyLabel");
      const hint = document.getElementById("panicKeyHint");
      const btn = document.getElementById("panicKeyButton");
      const toggle = document.getElementById("panicToggle");
      const input = document.getElementById("panicUrlInput");
      if (label) label.textContent = panicKeyName(panicSettings.key, panicSettings.code);
      if (hint) hint.textContent = panicCapturing
        ? "Press any key now… (Esc to cancel)"
        : "Click here, then press the key you want to use.";
      if (btn) btn.classList.toggle("capturing", panicCapturing);
      if (toggle) toggle.textContent = "Panic key: " + (panicSettings.enabled ? "ON" : "OFF");
      if (input && document.activeElement !== input) {
        input.value = panicSettings.url.replace(/^https?:\/\//i, "").replace(/\/$/, "");
      }
    }

    function startPanicKeyCapture() {
      panicCapturing = true;
      renderPanicSettings();
    }

    function stopPanicCapture() {
      if (!panicCapturing) return;
      panicCapturing = false;
      renderPanicSettings();
    }

    function togglePanicEnabled() {
      panicSettings.enabled = !panicSettings.enabled;
      savePanicToStorage();
      renderPanicSettings();
      showPanicStatus(panicSettings.enabled ? "Panic key turned on." : "Panic key turned off.");
    }

    function savePanicSettings() {
      const input = document.getElementById("panicUrlInput");
      const url = normalizePanicUrl(input ? input.value : "");
      if (!url) {
        showPanicStatus("That link doesn't look right. Try something like d303.schoology.com");
        return;
      }
      panicSettings.url = url;
      savePanicToStorage();
      if (input) input.value = url.replace(/^https?:\/\//i, "").replace(/\/$/, "");
      showPanicStatus("Saved! Press " + panicKeyName(panicSettings.key, panicSettings.code) + " to go to " + url);
    }

    function resetPanicSettings() {
      panicSettings = {
        enabled: true,
        key: PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY.key,
        code: PANIC_DEFAULT_KEY.code,
        url: PANIC_DEFAULT_URL
      };
      panicCapturing = false;
      savePanicToStorage();
      const input = document.getElementById("panicUrlInput");
      if (input) input.value = "";
      renderPanicSettings();
      showPanicStatus("Reset to the tilde key and d303.schoology.com.");
    }

    function triggerPanic() {
      const url = normalizePanicUrl(panicSettings.url) || PANIC_DEFAULT_URL;
      try { window.top.location.replace(url); }
      catch (error) {
        try { window.top.location.href = url; }
        catch (error2) { window.location.href = url; }
      }
    }

    function panicKeyMatches(event) {
      if (panicSettings.code) return event.code === panicSettings.code;
      return event.key === panicSettings.key;
    }

    function panicKeyHandler(event) {
      if (panicCapturing) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        if (event.key === "Escape") { stopPanicCapture(); return; }
        if (["Shift", "Control", "Alt", "Meta", "CapsLock", "Tab"].includes(event.key)) return;
        panicSettings.key = event.key;
        panicSettings.code = event.code || "";
        panicCapturing = false;
        savePanicToStorage();
        renderPanicSettings();
        showPanicStatus("Panic key set to " + panicKeyName(panicSettings.key, panicSettings.code) + ".");
        return;
      }

      if (!panicSettings.enabled) return;
      if (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey || event.altKey) return;

      const target = event.target;
      if (target && (target.tagName === "INPUT" || target.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || target.isContentEditable)) return;

      if (panicKeyMatches(event)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        triggerPanic();
      }
    }

    // Listen on this page, and on the outer page too (if the browser allows it) so the key
    // still works when focus is outside the embedded site.
    document.addEventListener("keydown", panicKeyHandler, true);
    try { window.parent.document.addEventListener("keydown", panicKeyHandler, true); }
    catch (error) { /* Outer page not reachable; this page's listener is enough. */ }

    try {
      const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PANIC_STORAGE) || "null");
      if (stored && typeof stored === "object") {
        if (typeof stored.enabled === "boolean") panicSettings.enabled = stored.enabled;
        if (typeof stored.key === "string" && stored.key) panicSettings.key = stored.key;
        if (typeof stored.code === "string") panicSettings.code = stored.code;
        const safeUrl = normalizePanicUrl(stored.url);
        if (safeUrl) panicSettings.url = safeUrl;
      }
    } catch (error) { /* Use defaults when storage is unavailable. */ }
    renderPanicSettings();

    /*
      ============================================================
      RECENTLY COMPLETED (shown in the Schoology theme's side panel)
      Remembers the last 4 things you opened, newest first.
      ============================================================
    */
    const COMPLETED_STORAGE = "ugsRecentlyCompleted";
    const COMPLETED_MAX = 4;
    let completedItems = [];
    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(COMPLETED_STORAGE) || "[]");
      if (Array.isArray(saved)) completedItems = saved.filter(x => typeof x === "string").slice(0, COMPLETED_MAX);
    } catch (error) { /* Start empty when storage is unavailable. */ }

    function renderCompleted() {
      const list = document.getElementById("sgCompleted");
      const empty = document.getElementById("sgCompletedEmpty");
      if (!list) return;
      list.replaceChildren();
      completedItems.forEach(text => {
        const li = document.createElement("li");
        li.textContent = text;
        list.appendChild(li);
      });
      if (empty) empty.hidden = completedItems.length > 0;
    }

    function recordCompleted(text) {
      completedItems = completedItems.filter(item => item !== text);
      completedItems.unshift(text);
      completedItems = completedItems.slice(0, COMPLETED_MAX);
      try { localStorage.setItem(COMPLETED_STORAGE, JSON.stringify(completedItems)); }
      catch (error) { /* Still works for this page view. */ }
      renderCompleted();
    }

    // Chat, Suggestions and Ratings buttons use inline onclick handlers, so catch them here.
    document.addEventListener("click", event => {
      const button = event.target.closest && event.target.closest("button");
      const handler = button ? (button.getAttribute("onclick") || "") : "";
      if (handler.includes("openConfigured")) recordCompleted("Joined the chat!");
      else if (handler.includes("openSuggestions")) recordCompleted("Opened the suggestion box!");
      else if (handler.includes("openRatings")) recordCompleted("Rated the games!");
    }, true);

    renderCompleted();

    function goToNav(index) {
      const buttons = document.querySelectorAll("nav > .nav-button");
      if (buttons[index]) showPage(buttons[index].dataset.page);
    }

    let savedLayout = "classic";
    try { savedLayout = localStorage.getItem("ugsWebsiteLayout") || "classic"; }
    catch (error) { /* Use the default layout when storage is unavailable. */ }
    applyLayout(savedLayout, false);


    renderGаmеs();
    renderAnnouncements();

    /* Falling autumn leaves: a few emoji leaves drifting down the screen. */
    (function createFallLeaves() {
      const box = document.createElement("div");
      box.id = "fallLeaves";
      box.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");

      const icons = currentLeafIcons;
      const count = 12;

      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        const leaf = document.createElement("span");
        const duration = 16 + Math.random() * 14;

        leaf.className = "fall-leaf";
        leaf.textContent = icons[i % icons.length];
        leaf.style.left = (Math.random() * 100) + "%";
        leaf.style.fontSize = (16 + Math.random() * 16) + "px";
        leaf.style.animationDuration = duration + "s";
        leaf.style.animationDelay = (-Math.random() * duration) + "s";
        box.appendChild(leaf);
      }

      document.body.appendChild(box);
    })();
    
  

    /*
      ============================================================
      GAME SEARCH
      Filters whatever game cards are currently in the Games grid
      (by the start of its title), so games you add to the list above
      show up in search automatically. Nothing to edit here.
      Cards that stop matching fade out, the rest glide into place,
      and cards that match again fade back in.
      ============================================================
    */
    (function () {
      const input = document.getElementById("gameSearchInput");
      if (!input) return;
      const wrap = input.closest(".game-search-wrap");
      const box = wrap.querySelector(".game-search");
      const meta = wrap.querySelector(".gs-meta");
      const clearBtn = wrap.querySelector(".gs-clear");
      const grid = wrap.nextElementSibling;          // the games grid sits right after the search bar
      if (!grid) return;

      const empty = document.createElement("div");
      empty.className = "gs-empty";
      empty.hidden = true;
      grid.insertAdjacentElement("afterend", empty);

      const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
      const canAnimate = () => !reduceMotion() && typeof Element.prototype.animate === "function" && grid.offsetParent !== null;

      // Fold case, accents, and look-alike Cyrillic letters so typing plain English always matches.
      const FOLD = { "\u0430":"a","\u0435":"e","\u043e":"o","\u0440":"p","\u0441":"c","\u0443":"y","\u0445":"x","\u0456":"i","\u043a":"k","\u043c":"m","\u0442":"t","\u043d":"h","\u0432":"b" };
      const foldChar = ch => {
        const d = ch.toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").charAt(0);
        return FOLD[d] || d;
      };
      const norm = s => Array.from(String(s || "")).map(foldChar).join("");
      const words = s => norm(s).split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean);
      const compact = s => norm(s).replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "");

      // A game matches when its TITLE STARTS WITH what you typed ("b" -> Blockcraft, Block Blast, Bloxburg...).
      // Spaces and punctuation are ignored, so "holeio", "hole.io" and "hole io" all find Hole.io 3D.
      function scoreCard(card, tokens, whole) {
        const h3 = card.querySelector("h3");
        if (!h3 || !whole) return -1;
        return compact(h3.textContent).startsWith(whole) ? 0 : -1;
      }

      const hasHighlights = typeof CSS !== "undefined" && CSS.highlights && typeof Highlight !== "undefined";
      function highlight(cards, whole) {
        if (!hasHighlights) return;
        try {
          CSS.highlights.delete("gs-hit");
          if (!whole) return;
          const hl = new Highlight();
          cards.forEach(card => {
            const h3 = card.querySelector("h3");
            const node = h3 && h3.firstChild;
            if (!node || node.nodeType !== 3) return;
            const text = node.textContent;
            let seen = 0, end = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < text.length && seen < whole.length; i++) {
              end = i + 1;
              if (/[a-z0-9]/.test(foldChar(text[i]))) seen++;
            }
            const r = new Range();
            r.setStart(node, 0);
            r.setEnd(node, end);
            hl.add(r);
          });
          CSS.highlights.set("gs-hit", hl);
        } catch (e) { /* highlighting is a bonus; ignore failures */ }
      }

      const allCards = () => Array.from(grid.children).filter(c => c.classList.contains("card"));
      const EXIT_MS = 300;
      const MOVE_MS = 700;
      const ENTER_MS = 650;
      const EASE_OUT = "cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)";
      const EASE_IN = "cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1)";

      /* ---------- step 2: the actual show/hide + reorder, with glide + fade-in ---------- */
      function settle(animate) {
        const cards = allCards();
        const stayers = [];
        const entering = [];
        const first = new Map();

        if (animate) {
          cards.forEach(c => { if (!c.hidden) first.set(c, c.getBoundingClientRect()); });
        }

        const want = cards.filter(c => c._gsScore >= 0);
        const raw = input.value.trim();
        cards.forEach((card, i) => {
          card.getAnimations().forEach(a => a.cancel());   // clear any finished fade-outs and old moves
          card._gsAnim = null;
          card._gsLeaving = false;
          if (card._gsScore < 0) {
            card.hidden = true;
            card.style.order = "";
          } else {
            if (card.hidden) entering.push(card);
            else stayers.push(card);
            card.hidden = false;
            card.style.order = raw ? String(card._gsScore * 1000 + i) : "";
          }
        });

        if (animate) {
          stayers.forEach(card => {
            const a = first.get(card);
            const b = card.getBoundingClientRect();
            const dx = a.left - b.left, dy = a.top - b.top;
            if (Math.abs(dx) < 1 && Math.abs(dy) < 1) return;
            card.animate(
              [{ transform: "translate(" + dx + "px," + dy + "px)" }, { transform: "translate(0,0)" }],
              { duration: MOVE_MS, easing: EASE_OUT }
            );
          });
          entering
            .sort((x, y) => (Number(x.style.order) || 0) - (Number(y.style.order) || 0))
            .forEach((card, k) => {
              card.animate(
                [
                  { opacity: 0, transform: "translateY(24px) scale(.95)" },
                  { opacity: 1, transform: "translateY(0) scale(1)" }
                ],
                { duration: ENTER_MS, delay: Math.min(k, 10) * 40, easing: EASE_OUT, fill: "backwards" }
              );
            });
        }

        empty.hidden = want.length !== 0;
        highlight(want, compact(raw));
      }

      /* ---------- step 1: fade out the cards that no longer match, then settle ---------- */
      function settleWhenIdle() {
        if (allCards().some(c => c._gsLeaving)) return;
        settle(true);
      }

      function reconcile(animate) {
        const cards = allCards();
        const leavers = cards.filter(c => c._gsScore < 0 && !c.hidden);
        const raw = input.value.trim();

        if (!animate) {
          settle(false);
          return;
        }

        grid.classList.add("gs-ready");   // stops the built-in rise-in from replaying on re-show

        // Cards already fading out may need to turn around (query changed again mid-fade).
        cards.forEach(c => {
          if (c._gsLeaving && c._gsAnim) {
            const goingOut = c._gsAnim.playbackRate > 0;
            const shouldGoOut = c._gsScore < 0;
            if (goingOut !== shouldGoOut) c._gsAnim.reverse();
          }
        });

        leavers.forEach(card => {
          if (card._gsLeaving) return;
          const anim = card.animate(
            [
              { opacity: 1, transform: "translateY(0) scale(1)" },
              { opacity: 0, transform: "translateY(12px) scale(.94)" }
            ],
            { duration: EXIT_MS, easing: EASE_IN, fill: "forwards" }
          );
          card._gsAnim = anim;
          card._gsLeaving = true;
          anim.onfinish = () => {
            if (anim.playbackRate < 0) {         // it was reversed back to fully visible
              anim.cancel();
              card._gsAnim = null;
            }
            card._gsLeaving = false;
            settleWhenIdle();
          };
        });

        if (!leavers.length && !cards.some(c => c._gsLeaving)) settle(true);
        else if (!raw && !cards.some(c => c._gsLeaving)) settle(true);
      }

      function apply(animate) {
        const raw = input.value.trim();
        const cards = allCards();
        const tokens = words(raw);
        const whole = compact(raw);
        box.classList.toggle("has-text", raw.length > 0);
        clearBtn.hidden = raw.length === 0;

        let shown = 0;
        cards.forEach(card => {
          card._gsScore = raw ? scoreCard(card, tokens, whole) : 0;
          if (card._gsScore >= 0) shown++;
        });

        if (!raw) {
          meta.textContent = cards.length ? cards.length + (cards.length === 1 ? " game" : " games") : "";
        } else {
          meta.innerHTML = "";
          const b = document.createElement("b");
          b.textContent = shown;
          meta.append(b, " of " + cards.length + (cards.length === 1 ? " game" : " games"));
        }

        if (!raw || shown > 0) {
          empty.hidden = true;
        } else {
          empty.replaceChildren();
          const emoji = document.createElement("span");
          emoji.className = "gs-empty-emoji";
          emoji.textContent = "\uD83C\uDF42";
          const msg = document.createElement("div");
          const strong = document.createElement("strong");
          strong.textContent = "No games start with \u201C" + raw + "\u201D";
          msg.appendChild(strong);
          const hint = document.createElement("div");
          hint.textContent = "Search looks at the first letters of each game\u2019s name.";
          const ask = document.createElement("div");
          ask.className = "gs-suggest";
          ask.textContent = "Want it added? Send us a suggestion \u2192";
          ask.addEventListener("click", () => showPage("suggestions"));
          empty.append(emoji, msg, hint, ask);
          empty.hidden = true;            // revealed by settle() once the old cards have faded out
        }

        reconcile(animate && canAnimate());
        if (!canAnimate() || !animate) empty.hidden = !raw || shown !== 0;
      }

      function clearSearch() { input.value = ""; apply(true); input.focus(); }

      input.addEventListener("input", () => apply(true));
      input.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key === "Escape") {
          if (input.value) { e.preventDefault(); clearSearch(); }
          else input.blur();
        } else if (e.key === "Enter" && input.value.trim()) {
          // Enter plays the top result.
          const top = allCards().filter(c => c._gsScore >= 0)
            .sort((a, b) => a._gsScore - b._gsScore)[0];
          const btn = top && top.querySelector(".button");
          if (btn) btn.click();
        }
      });
      clearBtn.addEventListener("click", clearSearch);
      clearBtn.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); clearSearch(); }
      });
      box.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {        // clicking anywhere on the bar focuses the input
        if (e.target !== input && !clearBtn.contains(e.target)) { e.preventDefault(); input.focus(); }
      });

      // "/" or Ctrl/Cmd+K jumps to the search box while you're on the Games page.
      document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        const onGamesPage = box.closest(".page") && box.closest(".page").classList.contains("active");
        if (!onGamesPage) return;
        const typing = /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test((document.activeElement || {}).tagName || "");
        if ((e.key === "/" && !typing && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey) || ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key.toLowerCase() === "k")) {
          e.preventDefault();
          input.focus();
          input.select();
        }
      });

      // Re-run automatically whenever the cards in the grid change (new games, re-render, etc.).
      new MutationObserver(() => apply(false)).observe(grid, { childList: true });
      apply(false);
    })();

    /*
      ============================================================
      FILE MANAGER THEME behaviour (only active in that theme)
        - single click selects a file, double click (or Enter) opens it
        - the title bar shows the current folder, the status bar the item count
      ============================================================
    */
    (function () {
      const win = document.getElementById("fmWindow");
      const content = document.getElementById("fmContent");
      const titleEl = document.getElementById("fmTitle");
      const statusEl = document.getElementById("fmStatus");
      if (!win || !content || !titleEl || !statusEl) return;

      const isFinder = () => document.body.classList.contains("layout-finder");
      let selected = null;
      let lastCard = null;
      let lastTime = 0;
      let lastTitle = "";

      function select(card) {
        if (selected && selected !== card) selected.classList.remove("fm-selected");
        selected = card;
        if (card) card.classList.add("fm-selected");
        updateStatus();
      }
      function openCard(card) {
        const play = card.querySelector(".button");
        if (play) play.click();
      }

      content.addEventListener("click", e => {
        if (!isFinder()) return;
        const card = e.target.closest(".grid > .card");
        if (!card) {
          if (!e.target.closest("button, a, input, textarea, select, .field, .gs-clear")) select(null);
          return;
        }
        const now = Date.now();
        if (card === lastCard && now - lastTime < 450) {   // second click in a row = double-click
          lastCard = null;
          select(card);
          openCard(card);
          return;
        }
        lastCard = card;
        lastTime = now;
        select(card);
      });

      document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (!isFinder() || e.key !== "Enter" || !selected || win.classList.contains("fm-hidden")) return;
        const tag = (document.activeElement || {}).tagName || "";
        if (/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT|BUTTON)$/.test(tag)) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        openCard(selected);
      });

      function updateStatus() {
        if (!isFinder()) return;
        const page = content.querySelector(".page.active");
        const items = page ? Array.from(page.querySelectorAll(".card")).filter(c => !c.hidden) : [];
        if (selected && !items.includes(selected)) { selected.classList.remove("fm-selected"); selected = null; }
        let text = "";
        if (items.length) text = selected ? "1 of " + items.length + " selected" : items.length + (items.length === 1 ? " item" : " items");
        if (statusEl.textContent !== text) statusEl.textContent = text;   // only write on change (avoids observer loops)
      }

      function updateTitle() {
        const active = document.querySelector(".fm-sidebar .nav-button.active");
        const name = active ? active.textContent.trim() : "";
        if (titleEl.textContent !== (name || "Home")) titleEl.textContent = name || "Home";
        if (name !== lastTitle) {
          lastTitle = name;
          select(null);
          content.scrollTo(0, 0);
        }
      }

      let queued = 0;
      function refresh() {
        if (queued) return;
        queued = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          queued = 0;
          if (!isFinder()) { if (selected) select(null); return; }
          updateTitle();
          updateStatus();
        });
      }

      new MutationObserver(refresh).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
      new MutationObserver(refresh).observe(win, { subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class", "hidden"], childList: true });
      refresh();
    })();

    /*
      ============================================================
      FILE MANAGER WINDOW BUTTONS + DOCK BUTTON (File Manager theme only)
        red    = close            (quick shrink + fade)
        yellow = window <-> full screen
        green  = minimize         (genie, funnels into the File Manager button)
      Opening from the bottom-left File Manager button plays the same genie
      animation the settings window uses when it opens.
      ============================================================
    */
    (function () {
      const win = document.getElementById("fmWindow");
      const dock = document.getElementById("fmDock");
      if (!win || !dock) return;

      // Optional wallpaper (set fileManagerBackgroundUrl in the configuration near the top).
      try {
        const wp = String(typeof fileManagerBackgroundUrl === "string" ? fileManagerBackgroundUrl : "").trim();
        if (wp) document.body.style.setProperty("--fm-wallpaper", 'url("' + wp.replace(/["\\\n\r]/g, "") + '")');
      } catch (e) { /* wallpaper is optional */ }

      const isFinder = () => document.body.classList.contains("layout-finder");
      const fg = { active: false, layer: null, strips: [], anims: [], g: null };
      let state = "open";          // "open" or "closed" (closed = closed OR minimized)
      let closeTimer = 0;

      function syncDock() { dock.classList.toggle("is-open", state === "open"); }

      function build() {
        const D = win.getBoundingClientRect();
        const B = dock.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (D.width < 10 || D.height < 10) return false;
        const n = GENIE_STRIPS;
        const h = D.height / n;

        const tpl = win.cloneNode(true);
        ["fm-genie-playing", "fm-hidden", "fm-closing", "fm-enter"].forEach(c => tpl.classList.remove(c));
        tpl.removeAttribute("id");
        tpl.querySelectorAll("[id]").forEach(el => el.removeAttribute("id"));
        tpl.querySelectorAll("[onclick]").forEach(el => el.removeAttribute("onclick"));
        tpl.querySelectorAll("button, input, a, [tabindex]").forEach(el => el.setAttribute("tabindex", "-1"));
        const srcInputs = win.querySelectorAll("input, textarea");
        tpl.querySelectorAll("input, textarea").forEach((el, i) => { if (srcInputs[i]) el.value = srcInputs[i].value; });
        tpl.style.setProperty("width", D.width + "px", "important");
        tpl.style.setProperty("height", D.height + "px", "important");

        const layer = document.createElement("div");
        layer.className = "genie-layer";
        layer.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        try { layer.inert = true; } catch (e) { /* older browsers */ }

        const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
        const strips = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const strip = document.createElement("div");
          strip.className = "genie-strip";
          strip.style.width = D.width + "px";
          strip.style.height = (h + 1.2) + "px";
          const copy = tpl.cloneNode(true);
          copy.style.top = (-i * h) + "px";
          strip.appendChild(copy);
          frag.appendChild(strip);
          strips.push({ el: strip, copy: copy });
        }
        layer.appendChild(frag);
        document.body.appendChild(layer);

        const srcScroll = win.querySelector(".fm-content");
        if (srcScroll && srcScroll.scrollTop) {
          strips.forEach(st => { const c = st.copy.querySelector(".fm-content"); if (c) c.scrollTop = srcScroll.scrollTop; });
        }

        fg.layer = layer;
        fg.strips = strips;
        fg.g = {
          n: n, h: h, W: D.width,
          dcx: D.left + D.width / 2,
          dBottom: D.bottom,
          bx: B.left + B.width / 2,
          by: B.top + B.height / 2,
          minW: Math.max(.05, Math.min(.22, (B.width || 56) * .8 / D.width))
        };
        return true;
      }

      function finish() {
        fg.anims.forEach(a => { a.onfinish = null; try { a.cancel(); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ } });
        fg.anims = [];
        if (fg.layer && fg.layer.parentNode) fg.layer.parentNode.removeChild(fg.layer);
        fg.layer = null; fg.strips = []; fg.g = null;
        fg.active = false;
        win.classList.remove("fm-genie-playing");
        win.classList.toggle("fm-hidden", state !== "open");
      }

      function go(dir) {
        if (!fg.active) {
          if (!build()) return false;
          fg.active = true;
          const frames = fg.strips.map(() => []);
          for (let k = 0; k <= GENIE_KEYS; k++) {
            const shape = genieShape(fg.g, gEase(k / GENIE_KEYS));
            for (let i = 0; i < fg.g.n; i++) frames[i].push({ transform: shape.m[i], opacity: shape.o });
          }
          fg.anims = fg.strips.map((st, i) => {
            const a = st.el.animate(frames[i], { duration: GENIE_OPEN_MS, easing: "linear", fill: "both" });
            a.pause();
            a.currentTime = dir > 0 ? 0 : GENIE_OPEN_MS;
            return a;
          });
          fg.anims[0].onfinish = finish;
        }
        const rate = dir > 0 ? 1 : -(GENIE_OPEN_MS / GENIE_CLOSE_MS);
        fg.anims.forEach(a => {
          if (a.updatePlaybackRate) a.updatePlaybackRate(rate); else a.playbackRate = rate;
          a.play();
        });
        return true;
      }

      function show() {                       // open / un-minimize
        if (!isFinder()) return;
        clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        if (state === "open" && !win.classList.contains("fm-hidden")) {   // already open: little hop
          dock.classList.remove("bounce");
          void dock.offsetWidth;
          dock.classList.add("bounce");
          return;
        }
        state = "open";
        syncDock();
        win.classList.remove("fm-closing");
        if (genieReduced()) { win.classList.remove("fm-hidden", "fm-genie-playing"); return; }
        win.classList.remove("fm-hidden");
        win.classList.add("fm-genie-playing");
        if (!go(1)) win.classList.remove("fm-genie-playing");
      }

      function hide(kind) {                   // kind: "close" or "minimize"
        if (state !== "open") return;
        state = "closed";
        syncDock();
        if (genieReduced()) { win.classList.add("fm-hidden"); return; }
        if (fg.active) { go(-1); return; }    // was still opening: fold it back in
        if (kind === "minimize") {
          if (go(-1)) win.classList.add("fm-hidden");   // the copy is already on screen
          else win.classList.add("fm-hidden");
        } else {
          win.classList.add("fm-closing");
          closeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            if (state === "closed") win.classList.add("fm-hidden");
            win.classList.remove("fm-closing");
          }, 240);
        }
      }

      function toggleFull() {
        if (fg.active || win.classList.contains("fm-hidden")) return;
        win.classList.toggle("fm-full");
      }

      document.getElementById("fmClose").addEventListener("click", () => hide("close"));
      document.getElementById("fmZoom").addEventListener("click", toggleFull);
      document.getElementById("fmMinimize").addEventListener("click", () => hide("minimize"));
      dock.addEventListener("click", show);
      dock.addEventListener("animationend", () => dock.classList.remove("bounce"));
      window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (fg.active) finish(); });

      // Selecting the File Manager theme always starts with the window open.
      let wasFinder = isFinder();
      new MutationObserver(() => {
        const now = isFinder();
        if (now === wasFinder) return;
        wasFinder = now;
        if (fg.active) finish();
        clearTimeout(closeTimer);
        state = "open";
        syncDock();
        win.classList.remove("fm-hidden", "fm-closing", "fm-genie-playing", "fm-enter");
        if (now) {
          void win.offsetWidth;
          win.classList.add("fm-enter");
          setTimeout(() => win.classList.remove("fm-enter"), 650);
        }
      }).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
      syncDock();
    })();

    /*
      ============================================================
      NOTIFICATION BANNER (iPhone style)
        - shows when the page is opened or refreshed, for 3 seconds
        - hidden completely if notificationText is empty or "NULL"
        - click and drag it upward: it follows the pointer. Let go past
          the halfway point (or flick it) and it flies away; let go
          early and it springs back down.
      ============================================================
    */
    (function () {
      const el = document.getElementById("ugsNotif");
      const bodyEl = document.getElementById("ugsNotifBody");
      if (!el || !bodyEl) return;

      const raw = (typeof notificationText === "string" ? notificationText : "").trim();
      if (!raw || raw.toUpperCase() === "NULL") return;     // nothing to show

      const SHOW_MS = 3000;
      let timer = 0;
      let y = 0;
      let drag = null;
      let gone = false;

      bodyEl.textContent = raw;

      function setY(v, opacity) {
        el.style.transform = "translate3d(0," + v + "px,0)";
        if (opacity !== undefined) el.style.opacity = String(opacity);
      }
      function offTop() { return -(el.getBoundingClientRect().height + 40); }  // far enough up to be off screen

      function dismiss() {
        if (gone) return;
        gone = true;
        clearTimeout(timer);
        el.classList.remove("ugs-in", "ugs-back", "ugs-dragging", "ugs-live");
        el.classList.add("ugs-out");
        const current = el.getBoundingClientRect().top - 12;      // where it is right now, relative to its resting spot
        setY(Math.min(current, 0) + offTop(), 0);
        setTimeout(() => { el.hidden = true; }, 700);
      }
      function startTimer() { clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(dismiss, SHOW_MS); }

      // pull down = rubber band (it resists), pull up = follows the pointer 1:1
      function follow(dy) {
        if (dy >= 0) return 26 * (1 - Math.exp(-dy / 70));
        return dy;
      }

      el.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
        if (gone || (e.pointerType === "mouse" && e.button !== 0)) return;
        clearTimeout(timer);                                       // hold the banner while it is being touched
        drag = { id: e.pointerId, startY: e.clientY, lastY: e.clientY, lastT: performance.now(), v: 0, base: y };
        el.classList.remove("ugs-in", "ugs-back");
        el.classList.add("ugs-dragging");
        try { el.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* fine */ }
        e.preventDefault();
      });
      el.addEventListener("pointermove", (e) => {
        if (!drag || e.pointerId !== drag.id) return;
        const now = performance.now();
        const dt = Math.max(1, now - drag.lastT);
        drag.v = .8 * drag.v + .2 * ((e.clientY - drag.lastY) / dt);   // smoothed velocity, px per ms
        drag.lastY = e.clientY; drag.lastT = now;
        y = follow(e.clientY - drag.startY);
        const h = el.getBoundingClientRect().height || 70;
        setY(y, Math.max(.35, Math.min(1, 1 + y / (h * 2.2))));
      });
      function release(e) {
        if (!drag || (e && e.pointerId !== drag.id)) return;
        const v = drag.v;
        drag = null;
        try { el.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* fine */ }
        el.classList.remove("ugs-dragging");
        const h = el.getBoundingClientRect().height || 70;
        if (y < -h * .45 || v < -.55) {                             // dragged far enough, or flicked up
          dismiss();
        } else {                                                     // not far enough: settle back down
          y = 0;
          el.classList.add("ugs-back");
          setY(0, 1);
          startTimer();
        }
      }
      el.addEventListener("pointerup", release);
      el.addEventListener("pointercancel", release);
      el.addEventListener("dragstart", (e) => e.preventDefault());

      // show it
      el.hidden = false;
      void el.offsetWidth;                                           // lock in the starting (off-screen) position first
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (gone) return;
        el.classList.add("ugs-in", "ugs-live");
        setY(0, 1);
        startTimer();
      }, 350);
    })();

    /*
      ============================================================
      INTERSTELLAR THEME: LIVE STARFIELD
        - you are always drifting forward through thousands of stars
        - the vanishing point gently follows your mouse
        - click and HOLD the background: the ship ramps up to warp speed
          (long streaks, glow, nebula rushing past). Let go and it eases
          back down to a calm cruise.
        - only runs while the Interstellar theme is selected
      ============================================================
    */
    (function () {
      const bg = document.getElementById("spaceBg");
      const cv = document.getElementById("spaceCanvas");
      const glow = document.getElementById("spaceGlow");
      const vig = document.getElementById("spaceVig");
      const nebula = document.getElementById("spaceNebulaWrap");
      const hint = document.getElementById("spaceHint");
      if (!bg || !cv || !cv.getContext) return;
      const ctx = cv.getContext("2d");

      const CRUISE = 0.085;        // forward speed while drifting (depth units per second)
      const WARP = 2.5;            // forward speed at full warp
      const PALETTE = [            // star colors: [r, g, b]
        [255, 255, 255], [255, 255, 255], [255, 255, 255],
        [176, 204, 255], [150, 190, 255], [143, 211, 255],
        [255, 226, 190], [214, 180, 255]
      ];

      let W = 0, H = 0, dpr = 1, F = 1;
      let stars = [], sprites = [];
      let running = false, raf = 0, last = 0, clock = 0;
      let holding = false, warp = 0;
      let mx = 0, my = 0;                 // pointer, -1..1 from screen center
      let vx = 0, vy = 0;                 // smoothed vanishing point offset (device px)
      let shoot = null, nextShoot = 0;
      let reduce = false, hintDone = false, hintTimers = [];
      const dimTargets = [];

      function makeSprites() {            // soft glow dots for the brighter stars
        sprites = PALETTE.map(c => {
          const o = document.createElement("canvas");
          o.width = o.height = 64;
          const g = o.getContext("2d");
          const gr = g.createRadialGradient(32, 32, 0, 32, 32, 32);
          gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(" + c[0] + "," + c[1] + "," + c[2] + ",1)");
          gr.addColorStop(.18, "rgba(" + c[0] + "," + c[1] + "," + c[2] + ",.55)");
          gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(" + c[0] + "," + c[1] + "," + c[2] + ",0)");
          g.fillStyle = gr; g.fillRect(0, 0, 64, 64);
          return o;
        });
      }
      function respawn(st, anywhere) {
        st.x = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        st.y = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
        st.z = anywhere ? .04 + Math.random() * .96 : .88 + Math.random() * .12;
        return st;
      }
      function build() {
        const count = Math.max(650, Math.min(1700, Math.round((W * H) / (1900 * dpr * dpr))));
        stars = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const st = respawn({}, true);
          st.ci = (Math.random() * PALETTE.length) | 0;
          st.big = Math.random() < .09;
          st.ph = Math.random() * 6.283;
          st.tw = .6 + Math.random() * 1.8;
          stars.push(st);
        }
      }
      function resize() {
        dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        W = Math.max(1, Math.round(window.innerWidth * dpr));
        H = Math.max(1, Math.round(window.innerHeight * dpr));
        cv.width = W; cv.height = H;
        F = Math.max(W, H) * .55;
        build();
      }

      function setDim(amount) {           // fade the page a little during warp so you see the stars
        const o = String(1 - amount * .5);
        dimTargets.forEach(el => { el.style.opacity = o; });
      }
      function clearDim() { dimTargets.forEach(el => { el.style.opacity = ""; }); }

      function frame(t) {
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        const dt = Math.min(.05, Math.max(.001, (t - last) / 1000));
        last = t; clock += dt;

        // ease toward warp / back to cruise
        const target = holding && !reduce ? 1 : 0;
        warp += (target - warp) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * (target ? 1.5 : 2.3)));
        if (Math.abs(target - warp) < .0004) warp = target;
        const e = warp * warp * (3 - 2 * warp);
        const speed = (reduce ? .012 : CRUISE) + (WARP - CRUISE) * e * e;
        const trailT = .016 + .085 * e;

        // vanishing point follows the pointer
        const pull = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * (2.4 + warp * 2));
        vx += (mx * W * (.07 + .07 * warp) - vx) * pull;
        vy += (my * H * (.07 + .07 * warp) - vy) * pull;
        const cx = W / 2 + vx, cy = H / 2 + vy;

        ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "lighter";
        ctx.lineCap = "round";

        for (let i = 0; i < stars.length; i++) {
          const st = stars[i];
          st.z -= speed * dt;
          if (st.z <= .02) { respawn(st, false); continue; }
          const inv = F / st.z;
          const sx = cx + st.x * inv, sy = cy + st.y * inv;
          if (sx < -80 || sx > W + 80 || sy < -80 || sy > H + 80) { respawn(st, false); continue; }

          const near = 1 - st.z;
          const tw = 1 - .28 * (1 - e) * (.5 + .5 * Math.sin(clock * st.tw + st.ph));
          const a = Math.min(1, .4 + near * 1.3) * Math.min(1, (1 - st.z) / .08) * tw;
          if (a < .02) continue;
          const c = PALETTE[st.ci];
          const r = (near * 2.4 + 1.1) * dpr;

          const pz = st.z + speed * trailT;
          const pinv = F / pz;
          const px = cx + st.x * pinv, py = cy + st.y * pinv;
          const len = Math.hypot(sx - px, sy - py);

          if (len > 1.6 * dpr) {          // streak
            // blue-white shift while warping
            const rr = Math.round(c[0] + (190 - c[0]) * e * .6);
            const gg = Math.round(c[1] + (215 - c[1]) * e * .6);
            ctx.globalAlpha = a;
            ctx.strokeStyle = "rgb(" + rr + "," + gg + "," + c[2] + ")";
            ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(.6 * dpr, r * (.9 - .25 * e));
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, py); ctx.lineTo(sx, sy); ctx.stroke();
          } else if (st.big && near > .35) {   // soft glowing star
            const d = r * 6.5;
            ctx.globalAlpha = a * .85;
            ctx.drawImage(sprites[st.ci], sx - d / 2, sy - d / 2, d, d);
          } else {                         // plain dot
            ctx.globalAlpha = a;
            ctx.fillStyle = "rgb(" + c[0] + "," + c[1] + "," + c[2] + ")";
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx, sy, r * .72, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill();
          }
        }

        // an occasional shooting star while cruising
        if (!reduce) {
          if (!shoot && clock > nextShoot && warp < .15) {
            const ang = (.35 + Math.random() * .4);
            const sp = (900 + Math.random() * 500) * dpr;
            shoot = { x: Math.random() * W * .8, y: Math.random() * H * .45, vx: Math.cos(ang) * sp, vy: Math.sin(ang) * sp, age: 0, life: .75 + Math.random() * .35, tail: (170 + Math.random() * 120) * dpr };
            nextShoot = clock + 3.5 + Math.random() * 6;
          }
          if (shoot) {
            shoot.age += dt; shoot.x += shoot.vx * dt; shoot.y += shoot.vy * dt;
            const k = shoot.age / shoot.life;
            if (k >= 1) shoot = null;
            else {
              const m = Math.hypot(shoot.vx, shoot.vy);
              const tx = shoot.x - shoot.vx / m * shoot.tail, ty = shoot.y - shoot.vy / m * shoot.tail;
              const gr = ctx.createLinearGradient(tx, ty, shoot.x, shoot.y);
              gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(180,210,255,0)");
              gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,1)");
              ctx.globalAlpha = Math.sin(k * Math.PI);
              ctx.strokeStyle = gr; ctx.lineWidth = 1.7 * dpr;
              ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx, ty); ctx.lineTo(shoot.x, shoot.y); ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
        }
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = "source-over";

        // glow, vignette, nebula rush and page dimming follow the warp amount
        glow.style.opacity = String(e * .9);
        glow.style.transform = "translate3d(" + (vx / dpr).toFixed(1) + "px," + (vy / dpr).toFixed(1) + "px,0) scale(" + (.55 + e * .9).toFixed(3) + ")";
        vig.style.opacity = String(e);
        nebula.style.transform = "scale(" + (1 + e * .45).toFixed(3) + ")";
        setDim(e);
      }

      // ---- hold to warp ----
      const NO_WARP = "button, a, input, textarea, select, label, summary, iframe, [onclick], [role='button'], .settings-overlay, .settings-launcher, .ugs-notif, .fm-dock";
      function onDown(e) {
        if (!running) return;
        if (e.pointerType === "mouse" && e.button !== 0) return;
        if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest(NO_WARP)) return;
        holding = true;
        document.body.classList.add("space-warping");
        endHint();
      }
      function onUp() {
        holding = false;
        document.body.classList.remove("space-warping");
      }
      function onMove(e) {
        mx = (e.clientX / Math.max(1, window.innerWidth)) * 2 - 1;
        my = (e.clientY / Math.max(1, window.innerHeight)) * 2 - 1;
        if (holding && e.pointerType === "mouse" && e.buttons === 0) onUp();   // released outside the window
      }
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onDown, true);
      window.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
      window.addEventListener("pointercancel", onUp);
      window.addEventListener("blur", onUp);
      window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove, { passive: true });
      window.addEventListener("resize", () => { if (running) resize(); });

      // ---- hint pill ----
      function endHint() {
        hintDone = true;
        hintTimers.forEach(clearTimeout); hintTimers = [];
        if (hint) hint.classList.remove("show");
      }
      function showHint() {
        if (!hint || hintDone) return;
        hintTimers.push(setTimeout(() => hint.classList.add("show"), 1500));
        hintTimers.push(setTimeout(endHint, 9500));
      }

      // ---- start / stop with the theme ----
      function start() {
        if (running) return;
        running = true;
        reduce = !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches);
        dimTargets.length = 0;
        ["main", ".topbar", ".footer"].forEach(sel => { const el = document.querySelector(sel); if (el) dimTargets.push(el); });
        if (!sprites.length) makeSprites();
        warp = 0; holding = false; vx = vy = 0; shoot = null; nextShoot = 2.5;
        resize();
        last = performance.now();
        raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        showHint();
      }
      function stop() {
        if (!running) return;
        running = false;
        cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
        holding = false; warp = 0;
        document.body.classList.remove("space-warping");
        clearDim();
        endHint();
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
        hintDone = false;
      }
      function sync() {
        if (document.body.classList.contains("layout-space")) start(); else stop();
      }
      new MutationObserver(sync).observe(document.body, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
      sync();
    })();

    /*
      ============================================================
      THEME SEARCH (inside the settings window)
      Type part of a theme name or a related word ("apple", "pixel", "dark", "glass")
      and only the matching themes stay. Enter picks the top result, Esc clears.
      ============================================================
    */
    (function () {
      const input = document.getElementById("themeSearchInput");
      const panel = document.getElementById("settingsPanelLayout");
      if (!input || !panel) return;
      const wrap = input.closest(".theme-search-wrap");
      const box = wrap.querySelector(".game-search");
      const meta = wrap.querySelector(".theme-meta");
      const clearBtn = wrap.querySelector(".gs-clear");
      const options = Array.from(panel.querySelectorAll("[data-layout-choice]"));
      const KEYWORDS = {
        classic: "thanksgiving fall autumn orange brown default turkey",
        sidebar: "harvest left menu vertical leaf maple",
        moonlight: "cabin cozy burgundy warm library",
        bottom: "dock console bottom bar floating",
        topbar: "compact slim header navigation",
        space: "interstellar stars galaxy warp rocket dark",
        ios: "iphone apple ipad old retro classic glossy 2007",
        minecraft: "blocks pixel creeper steve crafting",
        fortnite: "battle royale epic vbucks v-bucks lobby victory",
        roblox: "robux blocks sidebar",
        zelda: "link hyrule botw breath wild sheikah triforce nintendo",
        schoology: "school light dashboard classroom to do",
        finder: "file manager mac folders windows",
        imac: "apple mac dock icons desktop",
        liquid: "glass apple translucent shiny water ios"
      };
      Object.assign(KEYWORDS, window.UGS_PAL_KEYWORDS || {});
      const FOLD = { "\u0430":"a","\u0435":"e","\u043e":"o","\u0440":"p","\u0441":"c","\u0443":"y","\u0445":"x","\u0456":"i" };
      const norm = s => Array.from(String(s || "").toLowerCase().normalize("NFD")).map(ch => FOLD[ch] || ch).join("").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "");
      const words = s => norm(s).split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean);

      const info = options.map((el, index) => {
        const strong = el.querySelector("strong");
        const span = el.querySelector("span");
        return {
          el, index,
          name: norm(strong ? strong.textContent : ""),
          rest: norm((span ? span.textContent : "") + " " + (KEYWORDS[el.dataset.layoutChoice] || "")),
          visible: true
        };
      });

      const empty = document.createElement("div");
      empty.className = "gs-empty theme-empty";
      empty.hidden = true;
      panel.appendChild(empty);

      // The first 15 themes are pinned at the top; every other theme sits under "More themes".
      // (Change PIN_COUNT to pin more or fewer.) Both labels hide while you are searching.
      const PIN_COUNT = 15;
      function makeLabel(text) {
        const label = document.createElement("div");
        label.className = "settings-section-label";
        label.textContent = text;
        return label;
      }
      const pinLabel = makeLabel("\uD83D\uDCCC Pinned");
      const moreLabel = makeLabel("\uD83C\uDFA8 More themes");

      const reduceMotion = () => window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

      function score(item, tokens) {
        let total = 0;
        for (const t of tokens) {
          if (item.name.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).some(w => w.startsWith(t))) total += 0;
          else if (item.name.includes(t)) total += 1;
          else if (item.rest.includes(t)) total += 2;
          else return -1;
        }
        return total;
      }

      function apply(animate) {
        const raw = input.value.trim();
        const tokens = words(raw);
        box.classList.toggle("has-text", raw.length > 0);
        clearBtn.hidden = raw.length === 0;

        info.forEach(item => { item.score = tokens.length ? score(item, tokens) : 0; });
        const matches = info.filter(i => i.score >= 0);

        // Best matches first while searching; original order again when the box is empty.
        const ordered = tokens.length
          ? info.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.score < 0) - (b.score < 0) || a.score - b.score || a.index - b.index)
          : info;
        ordered.forEach(item => panel.insertBefore(item.el, empty));

        // Section labels only show in the normal (not searching) list.
        const searching = tokens.length > 0;
        panel.insertBefore(pinLabel, info[0].el);
        if (info.length > PIN_COUNT) panel.insertBefore(moreLabel, info[PIN_COUNT].el);
        pinLabel.style.display = moreLabel.style.display = searching ? "none" : "";

        info.forEach(item => {
          const show = item.score >= 0;
          item.el.style.display = show ? "" : "none";
          if (show && !item.visible && animate && !reduceMotion() && item.el.animate) {
            item.el.animate([{ opacity: 0, translate: "0 6px" }, { opacity: 1, translate: "0 0" }], { duration: 180, easing: "ease-out" });
          }
          item.visible = show;
        });

        if (!raw) meta.textContent = info.length + " themes";
        else {
          meta.textContent = "";
          const b = document.createElement("b");
          b.textContent = matches.length;
          meta.append(b, " of " + info.length + " themes");
        }

        if (raw && !matches.length) {
          empty.replaceChildren();
          const emoji = document.createElement("span");
          emoji.className = "gs-empty-emoji";
          emoji.textContent = "\uD83D\uDD0E";
          const msg = document.createElement("div");
          const strong = document.createElement("strong");
          strong.textContent = "No themes match \u201C" + raw + "\u201D";
          msg.appendChild(strong);
          const hint = document.createElement("div");
          hint.textContent = "Try a name like Minecraft or Zelda, or a word like apple, pixel, dark or glass.";
          empty.append(emoji, msg, hint);
          empty.hidden = false;
        } else {
          empty.hidden = true;
        }
      }

      function clearSearch(focus) {
        input.value = "";
        apply(true);
        if (focus) input.focus();
      }

      input.addEventListener("input", () => apply(true));
      input.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key === "Escape" && input.value) {
          e.preventDefault();
          e.stopPropagation();            // first Esc clears the box; the next one closes settings
          clearSearch(true);
        } else if (e.key === "Enter" && input.value.trim()) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const top = info.filter(i => i.score >= 0).sort((a, b) => a.score - b.score || a.index - b.index)[0];
          if (top) top.el.click();
        }
      });
      clearBtn.addEventListener("click", () => clearSearch(true));
      clearBtn.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") { e.preventDefault(); clearSearch(true); }
      });
      box.addEventListener("mousedown", e => {
        if (e.target !== input && !clearBtn.contains(e.target)) { e.preventDefault(); input.focus(); }
      });

      // Start fresh every time the settings window is reopened.
      const overlay = document.getElementById("settingsOverlay");
      if (overlay && window.MutationObserver) {
        new MutationObserver(() => {
          if (!overlay.classList.contains("open") && input.value) { input.value = ""; apply(false); }
        }).observe(overlay, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"] });
      }

      apply(false);
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
